question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Originally, when I was released from prison in 2005 (securities violations), I was unable to find a job. I found available resources designed to help those with records get back on their feet woefully lacking. Unemployment among those with records was/is staggeringly high, leading to recidivism rates of close to 75%. I knew there had to be a better approach.

I came up with a tech-enabled strategy, and began a plan for 70 Million Jobs, the first for-profit employment platform for people with records. I was accepted into YC and had success in profitably facilitating thousands with records land jobs. Unfortunately, COVID hit and cratered our revenue, forcing me to shut down the company.

I remained working in reentry (it’s been 15 years now), and hatched an idea to build a community for the billion+ people (globally) that have records, who uniformly express their needs for jobs, housing, community, medical and legal help. Commissary Club aims to address all of these needs by providing each user their own AI agent that doesn’t merely answer questions, but actually solves the problem. For example, regarding employment, it will create the resume, search for the jobs, apply for the jobs, perform interview prep, arrange for transportation to the interview follow up.

The agent will introduce members to other members. Set doctors appts. Award tokens rewarding good behavior. Truly agentic.

launches.tagline: Access our swarm of agent executive assistants with web navigation capabilities
launches.body:
Hey everyone, this is Ahmed, co-founder of [Tasker AI](http://www.tasker.ai/) 👋\
\
We built a tool that connects with SaaS apps and websites you use daily, automating complex workflows and executing deep research.

# **The Problem**

Task automation on the internet is a complex and challenging process ⚙️

* There are many data sources without APIs. AI agents struggle to access them 🌐. 
* Traditionally, businesses had to ask developers to write scripts to access data they wanted to monitor 🛠️. 
* There are lots of workflow builders. However, this approach still requires technical know-how, making it inaccessible for many users 🙅‍♂️🙅🏻‍♀️.
* Data is siloed among many different SaaS applications 🚧.

 

# **Our Solution**

[video](https://youtu.be/3vLztxJghR4)

\
With Tasker AI’s natural language chat interface, users can assign tasks and create automations through plain English instructions. Simply describe what you want to accomplish. The system automatically converts these inputs into step-by-step actions, providing visual feedback and validation at every step.

# **Features**

**Deep Search**\
Tasker evaluates webpage structure in real time. Agents navigate & adapt to changes with built-in error recovery & retry mechanisms. \
**Smart Outputs**\
Tasker collects the information and aggregates it in CSV, Google Docs etc.\
**Automatic Scheduling** \
Set all your tasks in your preferred cadence.\
**Agentic Workflows**\
Tasker is able to connect to all your apps and compose workflows in plain English.

# ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️

# **Apply for access** [**here**](https://51l9vfhgn41.typeform.com/to/lxVmgAOn)

Learn more at [tasker.ai](http://tasker.ai) & follow us on [X](https://x.com/TaskerHQ). \
The platform is built on TaskNet, an open-source agentic infrastructure layer. If you want to be involved, join our [Discord community](https://discord.gg/4Xt4ZM4pfD).

## **🧠 The problem: running a restaurant is overwhelming**

Independent restaurant owners juggle dozens of tools, dozens of vendors, and constant interruptions - all while trying to serve food and keep customers happy. Managing the POS, updating menus, pulling sales reports, figuring out Instagram posts, dealing with changing prices… it’s a full-time job _on top of_ their actual full-time job.

But the real bottleneck? **Information is trapped in systems that don’t talk to each other**, and most POS systems are clunky, hard to use, or just dumb.

---

## **🍳 The solution: an AI agent that _knows_ your restaurant**

Avocado is a POS system designed from the ground up to work with an AI assistant. Our agent understands your menu, your modifiers, your sales data, your customers, your staff - and it can take action across the system in real time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91825&key=user_uploads/258127/4f4d0889-0077-48bd-a427-72d160f30492)

You can ask it:

* “Add a matcha latte to the menu for $5.50”
* “What’s my best-selling item on weekends?”
* “Update all egg-based items to reflect the new cost of eggs”
* “Create a social media post featuring today’s specials”
* “Tell me which servers had the highest tips last week”

…and it just **does it**. Right away. No UI to navigate, no learning curve, no training required.

💡 This is more than a chatbot. This is a **restaurant-native AI agent** with full control over the POS, KDS, kiosk, and online ordering systems - like having a superpowered GM in your pocket.

---

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O2QaQdDJlb0

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: I started my entrepreneurial journey early, building my first company in Romania at 21. Over the next decade I launched multiple products and learned how hard it is for engineering teams to explain the value they create. The idea for Waydev came from firsthand frustration while trying to understand developer output beyond gut feelings and subjective dashboards. There was no clear way to measure engineering performance using system data, so I decided to build it myself.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer: I applied to YC because I believed Waydev could become a category defining product and I wanted to sharpen our execution with the best early stage accelerator in the world. It wasn’t an easy path. I applied 13 times before being accepted, and each rejection forced me to refine the idea, tighten the pitch, and improve the product. When we finally joined YC, the experience was transformative. The batch pushed us to move faster, simplify our messaging, and talk to customers every day. Demo Day helped us raise capital and accelerate our trajectory. More importantly, YC gave us a mindset of relentless iteration that still defines how we operate.

question_answers.question: How have you kept in touch with the YC community and continued to use YC resources & programs since the batch ended?
question_answers.answer: YC has remained a core part of our company. I’m active in Bookface, talking to other founders about growth, engineering metrics, and the future of AI driven development. Many of our customers and partners come through YC referrals. We share learnings with other B2B and infra founders, and we rely on YC’s internal forums, templates, and tools for fundraising, hiring, and pricing decisions. YC helped us get started, but the community is what continues to compound our progress.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer:
Waydev started as a simple tool to analyze Git activity. The product evolved quickly as customers pushed us toward deeper insights and enterprise scale. Key moments included securing our first Fortune 500 customers, launching integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps, and building out enterprise features like SSO, RBAC, and advanced reporting.

A major inflection point came when we recognized that engineering intelligence needed an AI native interface. This led to the launch of Waydev AI, our conversational layer that lets leaders ask questions and get insights instantly without dashboards. Today, we support both large enterprises and fast growing teams, and we continue to integrate AI deeply into how engineering work is analyzed and measured.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
Engineering is the most expensive function in modern companies, but historically it has been the hardest to measure. Leaders rely on anecdotal feedback, siloed dashboards, or lagging indicators that fail to capture the full picture of productivity, quality, and delivery. This lack of visibility leads to poor decisions, misalignment, reactive planning, and inefficient budgets.

We solve this by giving teams a unified intelligence layer that turns system data into clear, actionable insights. The problem is huge because every company depends on software, and engineering performance directly affects speed, cost, and competitiveness. I decided to work on this because I experienced the pain myself as a founder and saw thousands of teams navigating the same challenge.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our long term vision is to build the intelligence engine behind every engineering organization. If we succeed, companies will understand their engineering health as clearly as they understand revenue or churn. Leaders will make better decisions, teams will work in a more predictable and balanced way, and engineering will become a transparent, measurable, and optimized function. In the future we imagine, every company will be able to ask one question, “What is happening in engineering and what should we do next?” and Waydev will deliver the answer instantly.

In 2017 I launched Waydev, defining the Software Engineering Intelligence category — bootstrapped to profitability, recognized by Gartner and G2, and trusted by Fortune 500 teams at American Express, Caterpillar, Dropbox, and PwC.

name: Dailybot
long_description:
Dailybot is the coordination platform for software teams where people and AI agents work side by side.

As engineering teams increasingly operate alongside multiple AI agents — coding agents, incident responders, research assistants — the gap between what's being worked on and what the team can actually see has become a critical problem. Dailybot closes that gap.

Teams use Dailybot to run async standups, check-ins, retros, and custom workflows directly inside Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, and Discord. In Dailybot 3, those capabilities now extend to AI agents: every agent can report progress, surface blockers, and be monitored in a dedicated observability layer — all attributed to the humans who delegated the work.

The platform combines four capabilities: structured check-ins and forms in chat, AI-powered summaries and blocker detection, no-code workflow automation, and agent infrastructure (API, CLI, open-source skill pack, fleet monitoring). Leaders get a proactive view of what people and agents accomplished together — without adding meetings or dashboards to check.

Dailybot is SOC 2 and GDPR compliant, backed by Y Combinator (S21), and trusted by teams at IBM, Samsung, Pixar, and 8,000+ teams worldwide.

launches.title: Dailybot CLI: Your AI agents now report to the team
launches.tagline: An open-source CLI and skill that turns private agent work into team updates, approvals, and workflows in chat
launches.body:
Hey everyone! we’re Mauricio and Sergio, co-founders of Dailybot (YC S21).

**What Dailybot is**: a place for team updates, check-ins, and coordination inside Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, and Google Chat. For people and AI agents.

**TL;DR**: we built an open-source CLI so people, scripts, and AI agents can drive Dailybot from the terminal. Updates, check-ins, chat messages, forms, and more land where the team already works: Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, or Google Chat. **Ask:** ask your agent to try our skill ([**www.dailybot.com/skill.md**](http://www.dailybot.com/skill.md)), run one workflow that matches how your team actually works, and tell us which one helped you move forward today.

Dailybot skill: [**https://www.dailybot.com/skills/agent-skill/#install**](https://www.dailybot.com/skills/agent-skill/#install)

**Demo**

[**Dailybot CLI + Agent Skill: Connect your AI coding agent to your team**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rwopfsPzgSQ)

\
**The problem**

Teams are getting real work done with coding agents and scripts. A lot of that work still finishes in a private session. The rest of the team only hears about it if someone rewrites it into Slack or a standup.

So you get the usual mess: invisible agent work, stale status during a release, approvals bouncing between tools, and check-ins that someone rebuilds by hand for every new project.

**What we shipped**

Dailybot CLI. Same Dailybot account and team feed you already use, now from the command line. A few workflows we’re highlighting:

1. Agent update to team chat — done / next / blockers show up in the feed, without a human rewrite

The CLI is our answer to that gap. A bridge into the place the team already coordinates.

Hi! We are Mauricio Morales and Sergio Florez, the founders of [Dailybot](https://www.dailybot.com/product/ai?utm_source=YCLaunch).

Dailybot+ AI is a toolkit for modern work: a ChatGPT Assistant and an AI Workflow automation tool that takes asynchronous work and in-chat collaboration to another level. Compatible with Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, or Discord.

### **The Problem**

AI is the future, yes. But many people lack the knowledge and resources to effectively incorporate AI into their daily workflow, resulting in missed opportunities for creating impactful use cases.

### **Our Solution**

Dailybot provides a chat assistant and platform that simplifies the integration of AI into daily workflows. With our technology, anyone can access an AI assistant (ChatGPT) in the work chat, and can also implement use cases that leverage the power of AI.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70494&key=user_uploads/207324/1d5a25dc-bc23-4f36-8315-61af16175cf6)

We provide key building blocks for you to combine and build multiple use cases on top of your chat workspace.

The building blocks of Dailybot are: **Check-ins** for stand-ups or recurring surveys; **Forms** for any data collection; **Chat Commands** for in-chat customization; **Workflows** for setting up triggers/actions; and the **AI engine**.

The Dailybot Workflows provide a Zapier-like interface where users can define triggers and actions (one or multiple) that should run.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70494&key=user_uploads/207324/7c533a87-fd19-4145-a9c9-4450a49a0e53)

The Actions can be AI content generation, sending messages (DMs or channels), sending emails, or triggering other building blocks of Dailybot.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70494&key=user_uploads/207324/dc811400-636e-4ffb-8773-aaefa373ddc2)

### **A Few Examples**

* You run a **Daily Stand-up** (built with Check-ins), then, **when a blocker is reported**, an **AI Workflow is run**. It analyzes the blocker and then suggests the employee ideas for solving the issue/bocker.
* You create a **Form** that will be triggered with the in-chat command named “**product release**”, when the Form is completed an **AI Workflow is run**. It analyzes all the content of the release form **and generates a press release** that is posted into the #releases channel.
* You create an **anonymous survey to monitor team morale**. The **AI analyzes all the responses** and sends a summary to the head of HR (via email or DM).

We're passionate about making remote work easier and more efficient and our goal is to make DailyBot the best companion for your team’s work.

**Our Ask:**

We’d love to hear your ideas on what type of AI-powered daily workflows (in chat) will add value to your team, feel free to share the feedback at [support@dailybot.com](mailto:support@dailybot.com)

We offer a Free Trial, [**Try Dailybot here**](https://www.dailybot.com/product/ai?utm_source=YCLaunch).

launches.body:
👋 Mauricio and Sergio from [@DailyBot](https://www.dailybot.com/) here.

### **TL;DR**

DailyBot is a bunch of useful add-ons for your chat platform. Plug it into your chat and make Async Work a breeze for your team:

* 1- Running async Daily Stand-ups, natively integrated in the chat
* 2- Cutting unnecessary meetings with more types of recurring check-ins
* 3- Spreading love and team recognition with DailyBot Kudos
* 4- Socializing better with watercooler prompts and random 1:1 coffees

And developers can build simple in-chat functions for their day-to-day operations, without the need to learn chat-platform-specific APIs.

Available on Slack, Discord, MS Teams, G Chat.

### **The problem**

Async work is the new way of working for many teams. Most teams use chat in any form with tools like Discord, Slack and others. As chat becomes the main app that workers interact with everyday, it becomes necessary to give it more purposes.

New purposes include workflows like team check-ins, surveys, platform notifications, tools for social engagement, or custom commands to trigger actions.

Creating all this setup is a hustle:

* 1- You have to use many apps, bots, plugins
* 2- There is a lot of context switching, management overhead, more subscription fees, and more app fatigue for workers
* 3- Most bots are not designed for protecting security and privacy

# **DailyBot is the solution**

We are building the first super-bot for your chat. DailyBot comes with a bunch of use cases and features, all-in-one. Some workflows include:

**Check-ins:** track automatically what your team is up to. You can run async and written updates, agile daily stand-ups, retrospectives, or periodic check-ins like 1:1s.

**Forms**: create all-purpose forms that people can respond to in chat or on the web. Automate vacation requests, recurring feedback forms, and more.

Most apps take a lot of permissions to access data from your chat. This becomes concerning when you are using dozens of apps to build your team workflows. We are designing DailyBot as a privacy & security first company.

We are SOC2 Type II compliant, giving confidence to small and big companies about our work and data management practices.

Hey everyone 👋

We’re building Miniloop: an AI workforce platform that helps startups run GTM without hiring a full GTM team.

### TL;DR

**Miniloop lets startups hire AI GTM teammates that run outbound, follow up with leads, create content, qualify signups, update CRM/spreadsheets, and execute repetitive workflows across tools like Gmail, Apollo, HubSpot, Google Sheets, Slack, and LinkedIn.**

Most early-stage founders know they should be doing outbound, following up with leads, writing content, qualifying signups, updating spreadsheets, and keeping prospects warm.

The problem is that all of this work is repetitive, tool-heavy, and easy to drop when you’re also building product and talking to customers.

Miniloop lets you hire AI agents that learn your business, connect to your tools, and run those workflows continuously.

The goal: help founders and small teams run GTM consistently without hiring more people.

### Launch video

<https://youtu.be/NruQjXiSUZ8>

### What Miniloop does

Miniloop agents can run GTM workflows like:

* finding and enriching leads
* writing and sending personalized outbound
* following up with signups
* qualifying prospects
* creating blog and SEO content
* updating spreadsheets and CRMs
* sending internal reports and alerts

They work across tools like Apollo, Gmail, HubSpot, Google Sheets, LinkedIn, Slack, and more.

The goal is simple: give founders and small GTM teams the output of extra teammates without adding headcount.

We’ve been using Miniloop internally for our own GTM, including blog generation, lead collection, and signup follow-up — workflows that map directly to your current dogfooding setup.

### Why now

Early-stage startups used to scale GTM by hiring more people.

Now the best teams can stay smaller longer.

Instead of duct-taping together brittle automations, Miniloop gives you agents that understand context, run multi-step workflows, and ask for help only when needed.

### Who it’s for

Miniloop is especially useful if you’re:

* a founder doing marketing / gtm work yourself
* a small team without dedicated GTM headcount
* running outbound, content, lead routing, or follow-up manually
* spending too much time moving data between tools

If you’re running GTM or ops and want help automating the repetitive parts, happy to set it up with you.

Also grateful for intros to teams that are doing lots of manual GTM work across too many tools.

launches.title: Forage Mail - Simplify your inbox
launches.tagline: AI that solves email overwhelm. Not another mail app.
launches.body:
Hey Launch YC, I’m Richie, cofounder of Forage Mail! 👋

Forage has seriously changed my relationship to my inbox, and I'm excited for more of you to experience it.

[Watch demo video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fM9X4DhtlJk)

# **The Problem**

 Email is the glue that holds our lives together. Calendar invites, receipts, notifications, newsletters, (and more) all end up in our inbox. But, it's like a digital junk drawer that other people put things in and then we have to sift through them every day.\
\
And it never ends! Even if we get to the bottom today, it just fills back up again tomorrow.

# **What is Forage Mail?**

Forage is not a new email app you need to learn. It’s an AI that plugs right into your Gmail account and filters out your low-priority mail. Then, it sends you a clean daily summary with everything it filtered out—including a TLDR of every newsletter you received.\
\
Forage AI auto-labels emails, learns from your preferences, and gives you full control with custom rules. You can continue using any email app you prefer while Forage works in the background to streamline your inbox.

\
**Works with every mail app**\
Forage doesn’t replace your mail app. It connects to your Gmail account and runs in the background. So you can continue checking email as usual.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88022&key=user_uploads/77398/aa81e95d-0fc4-4db3-b556-d688020466f6)

\
**A beautiful daily summary**\
Forage sends you a daily summary email with everything it filtered out of your inbox. It groups emails by type and summarizes your newsletters—this makes it easy to skim, scan, and move on.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88022&key=user_uploads/77398/96d9596d-b4d9-4f30-b5a8-01e8db5aeed0)

\
**A TLDR for every newsletter**

Ever find it hard to keep up with your favorite newsletters. Now, you can get the key points in your daily summary email and decide which articles you want to read in-full. Forage even gives you an estimated read time for each article.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88022&key=user_uploads/77398/2321939a-c461-4a89-8993-b51a305de075)

\
**Protects your inbox from unwanted senders**

Forage makes it easy to unsubscribe from any sender with one click. You can also mute entire categories of email so they never show up in your inbox. Sometimes, senders don’t respect your unsubscribe request, but Forage is able to hide them anyway.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88022&key=user_uploads/77398/aa638edf-f448-422e-a003-f49726b5ea1e)

\
**You’re always in control**

Forage AI makes intelligent decisions so it works well out-of-the-box. It learns from your preferences so it gets smarter the longer you use it. You can also create custom rules so you can decide exactly how your email is handled.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88022&key=user_uploads/77398/418dd868-14e5-4f10-ae8d-b1f39fc27ef1)

# **How to get started**

Forage takes 30-seconds to set up. All you need to do is connect your Gmail account and Forage will create your first summary with the last 24 hours of email in your inbox. Then it will continue monitoring for new emails going forward.\
\
_We have a 14-day free trial, and you can get 10% off for life using the discount code LAUNCHYC10._\
\
We’d love to hear your ideas, feedback, and questions!\
\
Special thanks to all the early testers who have helped guide the product over the last few months. You all are real ones. Thank you!

name: Tenyks
long_description:
Tenyks (YC S21) is a Cambridge University spin-out building the World's Most Versatile Visual Intelligence Platform—think Snowflake for Vision or GPT for Video.

Problem: Companies today collect oceans of visual data (from cameras, drones, and satellites), but struggle to extract actionable insights. Current solutions rely heavily on manual analysis by call centres in locations like the Philippines or AI platforms narrowly focused on security rather than deeper operational insights. This leaves critical improvements in efficiency, customer satisfaction, and revenue growth unrealised.

Solution: Tenyks unlocks unprecedented insights by applying advanced multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs) capable of comprehensive video summarisation, retrieval, and visual question-answering. These VLMs are seamlessly combined with specialised analytics for emotion detection, activity recognition, object tracking, and even gait analysis. Our platform transforms ordinary visual footage into extraordinary operational intelligence.

Initial Focus: Starting with Quick Service Restaurants (QSRs), we enable operations leaders to instantly understand customer flow, kitchen efficiency, staff productivity, and quality of service using their existing security camera footage—turning previously inaccessible data into direct operational improvements and clear financial ROI. For instance, insights from Tenyks can accelerate the speed of service significantly; even a 1-second improvement in service speed could generate $30,000 additional annual revenue per restaurant. For a multi-unit owner of 100 restaurants, that's an additional $3 million per year.

Traction: We've recently secured our first Fortune 500 customer, joining other major enterprises, global system integrators, and high-growth startups trusting Tenyks for powerful, data-driven decision-making.

Why Tenyks: Our patented technology originates from the founders' PhD research at Cambridge University. Previously, we helped world-leading teams scale high-performing Vision AI in production. 

Recognition: Recognised as a Rising Star in Gen AI by Sifted, Best Product of the Year by Vision AI Alliance, and Company of the Year by Cambridge University (previously awarded to DeepMind).

launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81738&key=user_uploads/3186/9e3e30fb-3ddb-47e7-aabf-860697f5ffb5)

**TL;DR**

Bytebot uses AI to handle web data extraction and form filling. Developers use us to save time and effort, writing robust web scraping and automation logic that is reusable across many websites. Get started [here](http://app.bytebot.ai/auth/sign-up), and book some time with us [here](https://calendly.com/bytebot/bytebot-overview?back=1&month=2024-03).

**❌ The Problem**

Browser scraping and web automation can be incredibly time-consuming and complex, often requiring a detailed and deep understanding of the web elements involved. Traditional methods are slow to iterate and can be difficult to scale, especially for startups and large companies.

Today, you might:

* Spend hours building scripts, hunting through HTML for the right selectors/xpaths
* Waste effort debugging and maintaining scripts that break after page layout changes
* Struggle with captchas, IP address rotation

**💫 The Solution**

Bytebot simplifies and streamlines browser automation by translating your natural language prompts into intricate web tasks, from data extracting to website monitoring to form filling.

Benefits include: 

* Eliminating time spent hunting for selectors or xpaths, as you can just prompt what you would like to happen instead
* Allowing you to design scripts with  prompts that are reusable across multiple websites or domains
* Providing robust and self-healing scripts that can adapt to website layout changes or updates

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81738&key=user_uploads/3186/cb84607a-1f46-48f4-ad7b-c1c5f61dda6d)

**⚒️How It Works**

Bytebot lets developers focus more on the prompting and less on the maintenance. Instead of writing complex scripts, you simply describe what you want to do, like _"Add the item to the shopping cart"_ or “_Login in with these credentials_“ and Bytebot handles the rest.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81738&key=user_uploads/3186/5317da8e-9760-4477-9a23-45ea0db84bc8)

Behind the scenes, Bytebot takes a snapshot of a given webpage and leverages LLMs to translate prompts into the appropriate browser actions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81738&key=user_uploads/3186/27874219-8f4a-4fcd-8480-21d039d83be6)

**Speeding Up Automations**

Bytebot significantly speeds up the development cycle. Faster iterations enable companies to test and experiment with workflows without lengthy setup times. This increase in efficiency leads to higher ROI, as teams can focus on high-impact projects instead of getting bogged down by repetitive tasks.

<https://youtu.be/v2e3Z3suQTs>

**Versatile for All Users**

 Bytebot is designed for users of all technical levels:

* **For Companies with Existing Infrastructure:** If your company already has a mature Puppeteer or Playwright setup, Bytebot integrates seamlessly. You can quickly hook Bytebot into your existing scripts without overhauling your current system.
* **For Companies Needing Browser Support:** If you don't want to manage browser infrastructure, our Hosted Browser API has you covered. We'll handle running the browser, and you can interact with Bytebot without worrying about captchas and IP address rotation.
*  **For Non-Technical Users:** For the quickest setup and experimentation, our Playground (coming soon!) offers a no-code UI, with a live browser view.

**🙏Our Asks**

* [Sign up](http://app.bytebot.ai/auth/sign-up) to try Bytebot! Our tiered [pricing](https://www.bytebot.ai/#pricing) has options for individual engineers and companies of all sizes.

* Share Bytebot with anyone who is looking to streamline their web automation.
* If you have a few minutes to chat about Bytebot, book a time [here](https://calendly.com/bytebot/bytebot-overview?back=1&month=2024-03).

launches.body:
Hey! We’re Ram & Pranay, the cofounders of Sei AI.

**✨TLDR**

Sei AI helps banks, mortgage lenders & servicers reduce the cost of loan origination & servicing. Our AI agents speak to borrowers and assist loan officers & underwriters. We’re already working with banks & top 25 IMBs.

In 5 months, we've grown our contracted ARR 10x.

Our platform is

👉 3x more effective at scheduling online leads and converting to meetings

👉 75% reduction in time spent by underwriting manually reviewing documents

👉 Already deployed with large lenders and banks nationally

**❌ The Problem**

It costs lenders $12,000 to originate a single mortgage. If you've spent any time inside a mortgage shop, the shape of the day is familiar. Loan officers chasing the same three documents from the same borrowers for the third week in a row. Underwriters re-keying data from Encompass into a checklist and clearing the same conditions a thousand times a year. Servicing reps listening to voicemails about the same hardship requests. Borrowers waiting in long queues just to make their payment or get a question answered.

**Enter Sei AI**

We ship three AI agents, each purpose-built for a mortgage workflow.

**1. The Pre-Underwriting Assistant** that validates income, assets, credit & collateral documents against 500+ agency guidelines, drafts conditions, & surfaces exceptions. All at the start of the process. The AI communicates with the borrower for any missing or incorrect information and runs checks again to close the loop. This reduces back-and-forth with borrowers, clear-to-close, and touchpoints by teams.

Impact: One NASDAQ-listed lender reduced review time per loan from 4 hours to 45 minutes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102608&key=user_uploads/739737/ff15143c-a467-4f38-b16b-7d77a904b864)

**2. Voice AI** handles inbound and outbound calls across origination and servicing — borrower follow-ups, payment reminders, payoff and escrow questions, etc.

Impact: It’s already 3x more effective at scheduling online leads and converting to meetings, with one customer complaining that “A few of our loan officers joked that their calendars are now too full and they need to block hours off. That is the kind of problem we want to have.”

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102608&key=user_uploads/739737/170f9885-2602-4723-b1c5-348056679b45)

**3. Call Monitoring Agent** reviews 100% of borrower calls to flag potential regulatory violations (TCPA, FDCPA, UDAAP). Uniquely, it also surfaces the pipeline that quietly walks out the door on the same calls — payoff requests where no one pitches a recapture refi, life-event signals that should trigger retention plays, cross-sell openings missed on every HELOC-curious caller, and the behavioral patterns that separate top-performing LOs from the rest of the floor.

Impact: One large IMB went from 3% to 100% call monitoring, while reducing costs by 75%

**🤝 Team**

We’re Pranay & Ram

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102608&key=user_uploads/739737/619bde1a-b56f-46b3-957c-1e5d02d7d4d2)

Pranay (CEO) has deep experience in finance and real estate across companies Cloud Kitchens, PayPal, The World Bank & Deutsche Bank.

launches.title: Elements by Unlayer - Open-source React components for emails, pages, and PDFs
launches.tagline: Elements lets developers and AI agents create emails, web pages, and PDFs from the same React codebase.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We’re launching Unlayer Elements, an open-source React content layer that lets developers and AI agents create emails, web pages, and PDFs from the same codebase. Write once in React, render everywhere.

Today, we’re launching something new and open source:

# Unlayer Elements

An open-source React content layer for developers and AI agents to create emails, web pages, and PDFs from the same codebase.

GitHub: <https://github.com/unlayer/elements>\
Docs: <https://docs.unlayer.com/elements>\
Demo: <https://youtu.be/-ZoMlPYUbtk>

## **The Problem**

Every SaaS product eventually needs content creation.

At first, it’s just one transactional email.

Then it becomes welcome emails, password resets, receipts, invoices, reports, landing pages, PDFs, internal templates, previews, exports, and visual editing.

Most teams end up maintaining separate systems for each output:

* one system for email templates
* one system for web pages
* one system for PDFs
* one system for visual editing
* one system for exports

The content is often similar, but the implementation is different.

This becomes even more important now that AI agents are generating more code and content. Agents can create fast, but teams still need the output to be structured, reusable, version-controlled, and production-ready.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=105004&key=user_uploads/105300/5911c2cd-ca33-48e8-86ff-72e1ce4fcfe7)

## **What We Built**

We built Unlayer Elements: open-source React components for creating emails, web pages, and PDFs from the same codebase.

Developers can use familiar components like:

* <Email>
* <Page>
* <Document>
* <Row>
* <Column>
* <Heading>
* <Paragraph>
* <Button>
* <Image>
* <Custom>

Each output mode is tuned for where the content will live:

* <Email> renders email-safe table HTML
* <Page> renders responsive web HTML
* <Document> renders print-ready HTML for PDFs and documents

Same component system. Different surfaces.

A few examples of what you can build:

* Transactional emails
* Landing pages
* Web versions of emails
* Invoices
* Receipts
* Reports
* Internal template galleries
* PDF documents
* AI-generated content flows

Elements also connects with the broader Unlayer platform. Developers can define content structure in code, and when visual editing is needed, teams can bring that work into Unlayer’s Builder so marketers, admins, or end users can edit without touching code.

## **Our Ask**

We’re open sourcing this early because we want feedback from people building with React, Next.js, email, PDFs, templates, and AI-generated content.

We’d love for you to:

1. Try it and tell us what feels useful or missing.
2. Star the GitHub repo if you want to support the project.
3. Share examples of emails, pages, PDFs, invoices, reports, or AI-generated content workflows you’d want Elements to support.

GitHub: <https://github.com/unlayer/elements>\
Docs: <https://docs.unlayer.com/elements>

Would love feedback from the YC community.

Email: [founders@unlayer.com](mailto:founders@unlayer.com)

launches.title: Unlayer: AI-powered content creation for your product
launches.tagline: Let your users create beautiful emails, pages or documents with AI.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** [**Unlayer**](https://unlayer.com) is an AI-powered content creation platform for developers. It gives you **embeddable builders**, templates, APIs, and AI toolkit so your users can create **emails**, **pages**, **documents**, and other content directly **inside your product**.

<https://youtu.be/qp9t74G4VyM>

—

## The Problem

Almost every software product eventually needs users to create content.

Emails, landing pages, proposals, invoices, documents, announcements, templates, PDFs, and more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102816&key=user_uploads/105300/df31db0c-923c-4ac3-977d-bd881f9586d1)

At first, this looks like “just add an editor.” Then you need responsive rendering, templates, merge tags, asset management, permissions, versioning, exports, personalization, localization, and now AI generation.

A small feature quietly becomes an entire content creation platform.

—

## What We Built

**Unlayer gives developers the building blocks to add AI-powered content creation into their own products.**

You can embed visual builders for emails, pages, popups, and documents, then connect them to templates, file storage, exports, APIs, and AI workflows.

Your users can visually create and edit content. Your AI agents can generate, personalize, translate, and modify that content through APIs and skills.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102816&key=user_uploads/105300/c9995728-e131-44cd-93cc-d295f255cf1b)

Over time, Unlayer has grown to **1,000+ customers**, from startups to teams at **Netflix**, **Fidelity**, **Bank of America**, **Mastercard, Twilio, Chargebee**, and others.

That has given us a front-row seat into the same pattern: almost every product eventually needs users or AI to create content inside the product itself.

—

## Why AI Changes This

Content creation is moving from manual editing to assisted and automated workflows.

A user should be able to say:

* **_“Create a launch email for this feature.”_**
* **_“Translate this landing page into Spanish.”_**
* **_“Turn this proposal into a branded PDF.”_**
* **_“Personalize this announcement for each customer segment.”_**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102816&key=user_uploads/105300/639a8626-7790-4094-b684-c4800407a6c6)

But for AI to do this well inside a product, it needs more than a text box. It needs access to templates, design structure, brand rules, assets, exports, and the final builder where humans can review and edit.

That is what we are building with Unlayer.

—

## Our Vision

We think the future of content creation inside software has two interfaces:

1. A visual builder for people
2. An action layer for AI agents

People should be able to drag, drop, edit, approve, and fine tune.

AI should be able to create, rewrite, personalize, translate, export, and eventually ship content automatically.

Unlayer is the infrastructure layer that connects both.

—

## Backstory

We started Unlayer because we kept seeing teams rebuild the same content creation stack over and over.

**Email HTML is painful**. Landing pages need **forms** and scripts. Documents need **PDF generation**. Templates need **permissions**. Assets need **storage**. Every product needs customization. And now AI needs to work across all of it.

We have spent years solving these problems so other teams do not have to.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102816&key=user_uploads/105300/87ce4023-46cd-4d48-8e8a-06774d6c6bc4)

—

## Our Ask

If your product has users creating emails, pages, documents, templates, or customer-facing content, Unlayer will be useful for you. [Try it out](https://unlayer.com/)

launches.title: Nophin - Cresa, AI Analyst for CRE Deal Screening
launches.tagline: Cresa is like having an analyst who quickly filters out deals that don’t fit your criteria and speeds up due diligence on the ones that do.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr**\
Today, to screen a multifamily deal, acquisition teams manually import rent rolls and operating statements and conduct market research for comps before running assumptions to see if a deal fits their criteria; Cresa automates the entire process. Cresa is a fine-tuned multimodal Agent that handles key workflows for acquisition teams 24/7 so they can focus on high-potential investments. Cresa can screen deals using your preferred acquisition model, analyze deal documents, conduct market research, and generate comprehensive reports. Try Cresa’s [Rent Comp Research](https://cresa.nophin.com/) — no signup or prior experience is needed.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1vPVEDKdekU&ab_channel=NophinAI>

**Team**\
We're Kwadwo and Weeks, a technical team of second-time YC founders and CRE investors on a mission to revolutionize commercial real estate investing. Having experienced the inefficiencies in CRE investing firsthand, we previously built an end-to-end underwriting solution. There, we uncovered a major pain point for investors: the top-of-the-funnel bottleneck of screening deals, where they waste time reviewing countless deals that don’t match their buying criteria.

**Problem**\
Acquisition teams are bogged down by the manual tasks required to screen deals, from analyzing deal documents to conducting time-consuming comp research before testing assumptions in an Excel model. A thorough diligence process takes an average of two hours. The workflow is highly manual, yet each deal is unique, preventing easily scaled processes. These inefficiencies lead to missed opportunities and slowed decision-making, making it difficult to focus on high-potential opportunities.

**Solution**

Cresa is an AI Screening Analyst that automates multifamily deal screening and diligence processes. Cresa is the first fine-tuned multimodal CRE Agent that handles key workflows for acquisition teams 24/7 so they can focus on high-potential opportunities. Cresa can screen deals using your preferred acquisition model, analyze documents, conduct market research, generate comprehensive reports, and send emails.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84018&key=user_uploads/289172/1b4daad8-fe9f-4816-a301-4e41f11994ed)

**Cresa In Action**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qR4CZ4x0iVk&ab_channel=NophinAI>

**Key Highlights**

1. Specify your investment criteria, and Cresa will automatically screen and filter deals using your acquisition model — each time.
2. Cresa can analyze and summarize deal documents like rent rolls, T-12s, OMs, and more and answer complex questions.
3. Sync real-time data to your acquisition models and download the analysis in Excel.
4. Run dynamic scenarios within your acquisition model.
5. Ask Cresa to conduct real-time market research from web sources and email you or anyone on your team a comprehensive summary.
6. Cresa can help generate investment memos using analyzed financials and market research, summarizing key takeaways for stakeholders.

**Our Ask**

* Connect us to acquisition teams focused on multifamily assets.
* Try Cresa’s [Rent Comp Research](https://cresa.nophin.com/) — No prior experience is needed. Please give us feedback at [founders@nophin.com](mailto:founders@nophin.com)
* Follow us and share this post on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nophin/) and  [X](https://x.com/NophinInc).

\- Borrowers are taking out multiple loans from various lenders in order to repay other loans.

\- Borrowers take out loans to repay other loans and get larger loan amounts, which leads to customer indebtedness.

**What is our solution?**

* A data sharing network for digital lending companies to reduce fraud and default.

Hey everyone - We’re Priyansh and Sriyansh (yes, we are brothers!) and we would love to tell you about [Raven](https://www.raven.dev).

### 🚫THE PROBLEM

Businesses spend a lot of resources managing product notifications (think due-date reminders or verification codes). For example to send a payment reminder via SMS, Email & WhatsApp, you have to integrate multiple provider APIs like Twilio, SendGrid, then orchestrate channels basis user preferences and finally send the correct template on-time. The problem is -

* Since each notification has it’s own set of templates & configurations, it becomes complex & time consuming to make any changes.
* There’s no central visibility as the data is spread across multiple messaging providers. It is a pain for product teams to pull it from 5-6 diff sources, standardize and then analyze them.
* Ensuring deliverability is a challenge. Some messages like OTPs are critical and their delivery failures lead to huge business losses.

### 🎁OUR SOLUTION

A central platform that brings all your messaging channels & providers in one place, where you can orchestrate and analyze them - all without engineering.

* A single API to send notifications across channels via any of the 40+ providers like Twilio, SES, Firebase, Messagebird, Gupshup.
* A dashboard gives central visibility on all templates, logs & delivery metrics allowing product teams to optimize CX by analyzing what works and what doesn’t, reduce redundant messages and thereby saving tons of money.
* Reduces business risk by effectively managing delivery failures using failovers/retries across channels & providers.

launches.title: AnythingLLM - The all-in-one desktop AI assistant
launches.tagline: An all-in-one desktop assistant for RAG, AI agents, and more with privacy by default built for everyday people.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83788&key=user_uploads/223222/eb7f7465-98d9-4ad3-9186-0931eaee0de2)

—\
**tldr;** AnythingLLM is an open-source all-in-one desktop assistant that includes RAG, agents, embedding, and more — all in one package. AnythingLLM desktop requires little or no setup and _just works_ out of the box, while also being highly customizable.

AnythingLLM is also [open-source](https://github.com/anything-llm/anythingllm).

—

# The problem: Consumer AI needs to be the magic box

The problem is that there are no easy-to-use, privacy-preserving, and customizable desktop AI assistants for everyone. Many existing solutions are either too complex for a non-technical consumer, not privacy-minded, do not offer the needed customization for the consumer, or are point solutions - leaving the user to figure out how to connect the dots.

We figured out early on from our open-source "Chat with your documents" GitHub project that many consumers do not have a deep understanding of how AI works, nor should they have to just use any AI tool. They just want to chat with their documents or have a personal agent that can do things for them. They also want this to just work without having to setup a complex infrastructure. Starting a docker container, opening a term, or running a script is too high a technical barrier, but privacy is **non-negotiable**.

# Our solution: AnythingLLM Desktop

Our solution is AnythingLLM for desktop. It is an all-in-one desktop assistant that includes RAG, agents, embedding, and more all in one package. It is designed to be easy to use, privacy-preserving, and customizable. All of this is packaged in a way that is easy to understand and modify for even a consumer who only has a "Newspaper headline" understanding of AI could use it and get the outputs they were looking for without subscribing to a cloud service, installing any software, or having to setup any infrastructure.

AnythingLLM Desktop is designed to be that magic box that just works. It is designed to be a personal assistant that can do things for you. It is designed to be a tool that you can use to chat with your documents, use for work-related tasks, or even use for personal tasks. It strikes the balance between ease of use and information overload on how to set any of this functionality up and get value out of it.

# Why consumers use AnythingLLM Desktop

\- Installable native app with support for Mac, Windows, and Linux

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83788&key=user_uploads/223222/1471f232-d89b-4d2b-bf3a-e0cf88fced10)

\- Pre-bundled LLM provider to get started with any LLM quickly

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83788&key=user_uploads/223222/02f597cc-5d4c-462d-880c-f360b8044ff9)

\- Full RAG pipeline with support for any document type

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83788&key=user_uploads/223222/4ecf566c-a398-4f4f-91a5-f421f845f85b)

\- Built-in agents with support for any LLM - regardless of function-calling support.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83788&key=user_uploads/223222/5b8d6ef6-e807-4bc1-b934-4743c894c481)

\- Built-in embedding with support for any embedding model

\- Supports their preferred embedding model, vector database, and LLM provider - if they have one.

\- Ability to "tune" and "tweak" settings to get the best results as they become more familiar with the tool and what it is capable of

\- Extensible with a full Developer API for everything we didn’t build already.

# Why we are doing this

We are building AnythingLLM because we believe that open-source AI is the future. We are also building AnythingLLM because we believe that the accessible consumer AI market is underserved and has too many technical hurdles. There are many great tools and projects, but piece-mealing them together is certainly not the ideal way for a consumer to experience AI or leverage it properly.

We also believe open-source LLMs will always be at par for consumer use cases, and adoption and integration of hardware into consumer devices will be commonplace. AnythingLLM will be able to leverage all of these advances as time goes on while remaining privacy-minded.

# Our Asks

[Today, we launched on Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/anythingllm) and are looking for feedback and support. We are also looking for feedback on what else we should add to AnythingLLM Desktop to really make it a one-stop shop for everyone to use.

Contact: [founders@mintplexlabs.com](https://mailto:founders@mintplexlabs.com) | Website: <https://anythingllm.com>

launches.tagline: We're the simplest way for you to complete the purchase of property abroad
launches.body:
**TL;DR -** When buying a home abroad, Ruffo lets buyers complete the required documents 100% online instead of having to get on a plane, go to a foreign consulate, or hire a foreign attorney.

🙄 **The problem**

When purchasing real estate abroad, signing transaction documents is a huge pain. You either get on a plane to sign in person, take your chances going through a maddening DMV-like experience at the nearest consulate, or pay thousands of dollars to (often questionable) foreign attorneys for signing in your name.

The risks, hassles, and costs of today’s cross-border document completion process drives many buyers to abandon their purchase halfway through, and forces many other would-be buyers to hold back. On top of stifling the homeownership dreams of buyers, today’s process also costs home sellers, real estate agents and mortgage lenders millions of dollars in lost sales every year.

![](https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/FpPiykbH8NQkTX3KxSy3oAlLOemXqafh-x66kcjUbyD_pEjzWMJlXEP52n0JR8RdR7bmcO9piJm_DJTlNu-qKSdV3UM1IImfwNaMq1gxl1gbA9tY4sS_hcgzrUztnA759US0RIXp9_2I1Rp4o7clYK0)


😌 **The Solution**

We allow buyers to complete, sign and notarize foreign transaction documents from their computer or mobile phone in just minutes. Ruffo generates the relevant transaction documents and connects the buyer to a notary in the U.S. to sign and notarize online. Ruffo then obtains the required government certifications to ensure that the document is legally valid in the foreign country where it will be used. The end result is a seamless foreign document generation and signature experience that saves the buyer time and money, while helping home sellers, real estate agents and mortgage lenders close more sales in less time.

![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/8jFLBHCCeTIzLl_WorfdtCVagFyAHhQ1so48F_PnKiWNqP4WRGYqt3XfDytJJN3g24y0SrBsnHdoOHbA6lAurJT8zy6k8AtT7aV6V80DODrnooGLEvFFLSqONSZgBECBy1QIdspfRy-yWtYCs25XQQg)


**In the words of one of our customers:**

_“I’ve seen the difficulties other US buyers have gone through when trying to complete their documents \[for the purchase of property abroad\]. My experience has been completely different. Ruffo made the process quick and easy. I was able to complete it from my house, without having to go to a consulate or waste money.” -_ Rosa Parra, New York, NY.

🙏🥺 **The Ask**

1. **Introduce us to anyone you know who works (directly or indirectly) in real estate in Mexico, specially in areas frequented by tourists and expats like Cabo, Tulum, and etc.**. Real estate developers, agents, mortgage lenders, home marketplaces, mortgage marketplaces, appraisers, etc. Would love to chat with any of them!
2. If you or anyone you know is trying to purchase real estate in Mexico or the Dominican Republic, let us know! We’ll make it a lot simpler :)
3. If you know of anyone who has purchased real estate in a country they did not reside in, send them our way! We’ll pay them to tell us about their experience.
4. If you have ever had to deal with cross-border paperwork, we’d love to hear about it! Whether you loved or hated the experience, we’ll probably learn something from it and might learn of new ways our platform could create value.

launches.tagline: Jasmine automates common and confusing workflows, helping solar owners get paid!
launches.body:
Hi YC!  👋

We’re Nathalie, Dalton, and Matt from Jasmine Energy.  Today we are proud to launch our latest AI tool to help solar owners claim their incentives.

The U.S. solar market is booming. It took 50 years to reach 5 million installations—now that number will double to 10 million in just six. 97% of these are on residential and commercial rooftops, yet over 1.7 million homes are missing out on valuable Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) income. Why? Because REC (Renewable Energy Certificate) management is still manual, confusing, and built for utilities—not everyday solar owners. Jasmine Energy changes that. Our AI-powered asset manager puts registration, compliance, and sales on autopilot, making it easy to turn solar generation into recurring income—with just a few clicks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65777&key=user_uploads/421/1c122467-5767-4a4e-b073-e88acd17faf4)

**TL;DR: Jasmine is the first end-to-end REC management platform built for residential and commercial solar. We automate common and confusing workflows—helping solar owners get paid extra for generating clean energy.** 

### **The Problem**

**Claiming RECs requires too much overhead for small or independent developers. (it works fine for the utility scale developers who designed it)**

Residential and commercial solar generators lose time and money navigating an outdated, fragmented system for managing Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs).

The industry still relies on paper, pens, and people. There’s no single source of truth, no standardized documentation, and no digital infrastructure to support efficient operations.

* **Complex registry compliance:** Each generator must register with one of several regional tracking systems, all with different rules, document requirements, and verification steps.
* **Manual data reporting:** Uploading generation data, proving eligibility, and submitting documents are tedious, inconsistent, and prone to error.
* **Inefficient monetization:** Selling RECs means navigating opaque markets, unclear pricing, and a maze of disconnected brokers and buyers—without a unified platform.

### **Our Solution – AI-Powered Automation for the Solar Industry**

**Use AI to “read” details from PDFs and to interact with legacy government websites.** 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=65777&key=user_uploads/421/c7d2bd40-b6eb-4064-b70f-120b3eeb1ea9)

Jasmine replaces the outdated, paper-based REC management process with an AI-powered platform purpose-built for residential and commercial solar generators.

Our asset manager brings structure, standardization, and automation to an industry still running on spreadsheets and guesswork:

* **Automated registration:** Jasmine handles the full lifecycle of registration, reporting, and verification across all major tracking systems—no paperwork, no confusion.
* **Instant data processing:** Our AI ingests, validates, and submits generation data directly from inverters or utility portals to ensure RECs are accurately and efficiently issued.
* **Transparent payouts:** Track your REC sales in real time and get paid faster, with full visibility into pricing, status, and transaction history.

Jasmine turns a fragmented, manual process into a seamless, digital experience—so solar owners can focus on generating power, not paperwork.

### **Key Features**

📝 **Automated Asset Registration** – Jasmine handles onboarding your residential or commercial solar system into the appropriate REC tracking registry, eliminating paperwork and manual errors.

✅ **AI-Powered Data Validation** – Our platform connects to your inverter or utility portal to automatically validate and submit generation data in real time—ensuring fast, compliant REC issuance.

Hi Everyone! [Nathalie](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nathaliecapati-energy/), [Dalton](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tdaltonc/), and [Matt](https://linkedin.com/in/matthewmayberry) here to (re)introduce [**Jasmine Energy**](https://jasmine.energy/) 🔋

On Jasmine, anyone can claim, sell, buy, and retire [energy attributes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Energy_certificate) directly.

Energy attribute certificates (EACs) (sometimes called Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs)  are a $10B market that is stuck in a time capsule from the fax machine era. Today's EAC market is confusing and time-consuming, taking weeks to register and days to trade.\
\
We are on a mission to accelerate the net-zero transition by building climate asset markets that are accessible, transparent, and efficient.

**💢 The Problem**

RECs are a valuable source of revenue for renewable energy generators and are worth up to $500/MWh! The problem is EACs are still traded using phone calls and fax machines. The whole process is confusing and time-consuming, taking weeks to register and days to trade. Middlemen currently keep up to 30% of trade value. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73943&key=user_uploads/89898/29c68bd5-72fe-4072-86fc-e6d3b32cc819)

**🤝 The Solution**

On Jasmine, anyone can buy and sell EACs at a posted price, permissionless, with settlement in seconds.  

Jasmine helps users manage their renewable energy assets by bridging RECs onto the blockchain and enabling DeFi transactions that are impossible in the existing markets. When a tokenized EAC is retired, Jasmine handles regulatory filings and auditing (filing paperwork, making phone calls, etc).

Jasmine provides the infrastructure to make every step of the buy and sell side process more efficient and transparent, allowing renewable energy generators to make more money, enabling commercial buyers to have a verifiable audit trail of their energy consumption, and giving energy traders the tools to operate more efficiently.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73943&key=user_uploads/89898/1700472b-a8b3-49b3-8eac-f0bb4076432b)

**♻️ How does this directly help the climate?**

Under business as usual, we're not going to build enough global clean energy capacity to hit our 2050 goal of (1) electrifying the economy, (2) decarbonizing the electricity grid, and (3) improving people's quality of life by expanding access to affordable electricity. 

A more liquid EAC market will make renewable energy projects less risky to finance, attracting new investors to accelerate the grid’s decarbonization.  We’re bringing those EACs onto the blockchain not just for the transparency and liquidity benefits, but also because DeFi will quickly generate the financial derivatives to further incentivize project financing.

launches.body:
# **TL;DR:**

[Brewit](https://brewit.ai/?utm_source=yc_launch) helps companies build a business intelligence agent on top of their database and data knowledge. Regardless of their previous technical abilities, anyone can get their data questions answered with beautiful visualizations and insightful interpretations within seconds. Brewit will understand your data schema knowledge, write SQL, and generate the relevant charts behind the scene. It also self-improves as users provide more feedback. [Watch our demo video!](https://www.loom.com/share/f1d6ad7a8d1e4cab97a9fda0f7a6b1be?sid=8e6e0f14-69e0-4846-9761-7287d9c45d21)

### **❌ The Problem**

**Ad-hoc data questions are almost never answered on time:** A mid-sized data team can receive hundreds of data requests per week; on average, it takes 1-2 weeks for these questions to be answered. Not only does this slow down the decision-making process, but it can also derail the data teams from focusing on more meaningful projects.

**Not everyone has the time to learn SQL and visualization tools:** It can take months for someone to master SQL or tools like Tableau, and without these skills, it is hard for someone to perform in-depth analysis or explore the database independently.

**LLM can hallucinate without the relevant context:** Many people use ChatGPT's code interpreter to perform data analysis on specific business tables, but without having the full picture of the company's data schemas and knowledge (aka a semantic layer), ChatGPT often "hallucinates" with inaccurate answers. In addition, companies have no oversight of the questions being asked.

### **✨ Our Solution**

1\. **Fine-tune** the LLM based on your data dictionary and metrics definitions. The agent will self-improve upon users' feedback and corrections

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80234&key=user_uploads/557708/57721199-8881-4b54-a514-df2a0cf01770)

2\. Human-like **analytics** **agent** that can clarify your question, answer it with relevant visualizations, and help you to drill down to uncover more insights, all through natural language

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80234&key=user_uploads/557708/b5ab39eb-f87b-41c6-9f31-704d71050c3a)

3\. Build **reports** with AI-generated insights

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80234&key=user_uploads/557708/ab52f79c-13b6-400e-9931-e7fe2778cdb0)

4\. Save your charts into a **dashboard** and track your key metrics in one place

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80234&key=user_uploads/557708/7c2a48ad-8ff0-407d-8ae5-76aca04df540)

5\. 🔒 Enterprise-level security: You can self-host Brewit in your environment, select your preferred LLM, and integrate with your favorite IM such as Slack

### **🙏 Ask**

We're live with customers now! Feel free to book a [time](https://brewit.ai/contact) or email [leo@brewit.ai](mailto:leo@brewit.ai) to see a demo.

Give Brewit a [try](https://app.brewit.ai/) - we've connected a demo database for you to play around with the app :)

Connect us to data and analytics leaders in your network!

launches.tagline: Meet Lynx, the platform to help engineers resolve oncall incidents faster!
launches.body:
[Lynx](https://uselynx.ai) is an AI-powered incident resolution platform that helps engineers diagnose and resolve on-call issues faster. If you’ve ever been woken up at 2 AM for a production incident and spent hours piecing together logs, metrics, and documentation, Lynx can help. Sign up on our [website](https://www.uselynx.ai/getstarted), reach out to us at [founders@uselynx.ai](mailto:founders@uselynx.ai), or schedule a time with us on [Calendly](https://calendly.com/codecompleteai/lynx-demo).

### The Problem

Software engineering has evolved, but on-call hasn’t. Even with the best observability tools, finding the root cause is slow and frustrating: systems grow more complex, documentation becomes scattered, and tribal knowledge gets lost as engineers leave the company.

Companies need a faster, more intelligent way to diagnose and resolve issues.

### Our Solution

Lynx is an AI-powered **incident resolution platform** that allows engineers to easily investigate and resolve issues directly in their development environment.

Check out our product [demo](https://youtu.be/atzdMyd7PG0)!

When incidents arise, **Lynx will automatically gather information, pinpoint root causes, and perform actions to help fix the issue**. Lynx lives on your dev server, so it can connect with all the tools and integrations in your environment. You can directly run code or execute commands on the Lynx platform in order to resolve your issues.

[Lynx Demo - Directly Resolve Incidents](https://youtu.be/TbvYtI5SstQ)

We built out chain-of-thought command execution so Lynx can automatically generate queries step-by-step and retrieve all the context it needs.

[Lynx Demo - Chain of Thought Command Execution](https://youtu.be/EANK62F75Pc)

We implemented several safeguards to ensure Lynx only executes read-only commands, but if you want a bit more control, you can opt to manually approve each command before it runs:

[Lynx Demo - Manual Command Execution](https://youtu.be/oGUpwGSPdVQ)

Lynx focuses on helping engineers **resolve** incidents instead of just managing them.

### Why We’re Building This

We started by building self-hosted, fine-tuned AI coding assistants, but we quickly realized coding was just a fraction of an engineer’s workflow. Teams spend just as much—if not more—time testing, debugging, and deploying.

We saw an opportunity to apply AI beyond generating new code, with on-call standing out as a major pain point. Engineers were losing hours digging through logs, retracing past incidents, and manually correlating data across tools.

Lynx was created to streamline incident resolution, but it goes beyond just on-call incidents. Our vision is to create an AI agent that can understands all the ins and outs of your tech stack so it can predict, investigate, and resolve any technical issue.

### **Ask: How you can help**

If your team has a heavy on-call burden, we'd love to chat about your workflows and pain points.

* Try out our product! Sign up for our waitlist: <https://www.uselynx.ai/getstarted>
* Introduce us to engineering leaders or teams who might benefit from Lynx.

Questions? Visit our [website](https://uselynx.ai/), reach out to [founders@uselynx.ai](mailto:founders@uselynx.ai), or schedule a time with us on [Calendly](https://calendly.com/codecompleteai/lynx-demo).

launches.body:
### **TLDR**

[CodeComplete](http://codecomplete.ai) is GitHub Copilot for Enterprise. Large companies can't use Copilot because of the security and privacy risks, so we're building a self-hosted version that’s also fine-tuned to the company's codebase. 

**If you (or if you know anyone else who):**

* **Would like to use Copilot at work but cannot, or**
* **Would like a version of Copilot that’s fine tuned to your enterprise codebase**

Please reach out to us at [founders@codecomplete.ai](mailto:founders@codecomplete.ai) or schedule a time with us on [Calendly](https://calendly.com/lydia-codecomplete/intro). 

—

---

Hi everyone, we’re Max and Lydia, and we’re building CodeComplete: an AI-powered code assistant built for enterprise companies. We’re incredibly excited about the advances in generative AI and are on a mission to transform the way developers work. Our code completion product is the first in a suite of AI-powered dev tools we’d like to build. 

### **The problem**

We love GitHub Copilot, but in order to use it, you need to send your code to GitHub, Microsoft, and OpenAI. Many large enterprise companies strictly forbid this due to **security and privacy concerns**, so they cannot leverage AI-powered dev tools to multiply their productivity.

Also, the underlying **Copilot model is not tuned to your codebase**, so you don't always get relevant suggestions. It’s best practice for developers to use their company’s frameworks and libraries. However, without fine tuning, code generation models can suggest generic code, which decreases legibility and introduces technical debt, performance issues, and security holes in the codebase.

### **The solution**

CodeComplete is a **self-hosted AI coding assistant tool that's fine tuned to your codebase**. We train powerful code generation base models on your codebase so we can deliver more relevant suggestions. We deploy these models directly on-premises or in your own cloud, so your valuable intellectual property stays with your company. With CodeComplete, your team can leverage cutting-edge AI technology to be more productive, quickly ramp up developers, and write better code while staying security compliant.

**Demo**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69046&key=user_uploads/1160505/0dbe9136-8d6c-415f-a09e-c6f81bba8ddb)

### **Why we’re building this**

Max wanted to use GitHub Copilot at Meta, but leadership explicitly blocked him from doing so. We believe AI-powered dev tools are the future, and we think they can be especially powerful and deliver value at larger companies. We want to set companies up for success in the long run by helping the millions of developers at these companies leverage new AI technology.

**Buy vs. Build**

This is not a core competency for many large enterprises. Buying a solution will save millions by freeing up engineering resources and catapulting dev velocity. 

### **Ask: How you can help**

* Connect us to an engineering leader at a large company that needs our product. [Email us](mailto:founders@codecomplete.ai)!
* Connect us to engineers who really want to use Copilot but cannot. [Email us](mailto:founders@codecomplete.ai)!
* Try out our product. Sign up on our [website](https://www.codecomplete.ai/)!
* **We will provide a $500 referral bonus if your referral becomes a paying customer.**

# **What does LinkGrep do?**

### **🔗 Automatically keeps track of all of your teams links**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70677&key=user_uploads/6421/29f93fd5-7b6a-4a72-b26f-028ca3a1b595)

### **✨ Suggests information from your knowledge bases while you browse**

LinkGrep can automatically connect the dots for you and will display related information from your browser history + team knowledge bases (like Slack & Notion) while you browse. LinkGrep also offers traditional semantic search if you ever want to manually search for things too.

launches.tagline: Register Frigade as one tool and your agent can generate in-product guides on demand, or answer questions grounded in how your product actually works today.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, Christian and Eric here, co-founders of Frigade (W23).

Today we are launching the Frigade Assist API, which levels up your own AI agent to better onboard and support your users with a single tool call.\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-j7wd0gYS2M>

**PROBLEM**

More and more teams are building their own agents. When a user gets stuck and needs help, companies tend to go one of two ways.

1. Buy a help agent (Frigade Assistant, Fin, etc.). Now you have two agents and two chatboxes, and your users cannot tell which one to use for what.
2. Have your own agent handle it. Agents in that case usually answer out of a knowledge base or help center with basic RAG. Docs are stale or incomplete more often than not, and even when the snippet is right it puts the work back on the user, who has to read it and then figure out how to apply it in the app.

**SOLUTION**

We already solved the docs problem with Frigade. Our browser agent signs in to your product with the same permissions a real user has, works through your real workflows, and maps how your product works. No manual documentation or screenshots to take. It trains again every time you ship, so it always knows the version of your product that's live.

Now, with the Assist API, we can solve the two-agent problem too.

The Assist API a single tool call. Your agent calls it and gets back an answer grounded in how your product behaves today, or a personalized walkthrough rendered on the page the user is already on. For most AI agent frameworks, you can add it with just these lines of code:

```
import { frigade } from '@frigade/ai'
 
const frigade_guide_tool = {
  description: 'Call this tool to answer product ' +
    'questions or guide the user through a task.',
  parameters: {
    query: {
      type: 'string',
      description: 'What the user is asking or wants to do',
    },
  },
  run: ({ query }) => frigade.assist({ query }),
}
 
```

The SDK forwards the call to the browser and Frigade acts on the page the user is on, highlighting the real element with the next step attached. Your agent decides when to call it and stays the only thing your user talks to.

What you get with it:

1. **Personalized in-product guides**, generated on demand. A new user gets walked through first-time setup without leaving the page. Someone stuck mid-workflow gets shown the next step instead of a link to an article.
2. **Visibility and control for the people who own support**. Your support and product teams see who Frigade is helping and where, and can steer the output without any engineering help.

We are already working with Retell AI to extend their agent's onboarding capabilities. They build agents for a living and still chose to plug in Frigade rather than build something like this themselves.

This is for teams who already own an agent and care about product adoption. And if you do not have an agent, our drop-in Frigade Assistant is still the fastest path.

If you want to give it a spin, reach out and we'll get you a demo. <https://frigade.com/assist-api>

Christian and Eric

launches.title: Frigade Skills: the in-app AI agent that learns your product and acts for your users
launches.tagline: Frigade learns your product by using it, then takes real actions for your users through Skills your team approves with no code.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, Eric and Christian here, co-founders of [Frigade](https://frigade.com) (W23).

Frigade is an AI agent that lives inside your product and [guides users through it](https://frigade.com/blog/product-help-where-users-stuck). Point it at your app and it learns your UI in minutes. You don't wire anything up or write docs.

**Today we're launching a major new upgrade to our agent called [Skills](https://frigade.com/features/skills).**

So far, Frigade has guided users and [answered their questions](https://frigade.com/blog/how-to-deflect-support-tickets). With Skills, it can take real actions for them too: looking things up, creating, editing, deleting.

Skills are the actions Frigade figures out on its own while it trains on your product. It documents each one, your team approves it with no code from the dashboard, and from then on Frigade runs it for any user who needs it. You can still wire in your own custom tool calls with our SDK, too.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bi-BFV7M7eY>

If you've used Linear's AI agent, Frigade is that as an embed: the same kind of in-app agent, dropped into your product with [one snippet](https://frigade.com/blog/walkme-alternatives-without-six-month-rollout). You get about 80% of it out of the box, with no eng work required.

**How it works:**

1. Add the snippet. Frigade starts using your product and learns it, like a new user would.
2. It turns the actions it finds into Skills. Your team reviews and approves them, no code.
3. Frigade runs those Skills for your users and answers their questions as they go.

**Here it is running on popular products we don't embed in.**

We just pointed it at each one and let it learn to see how it performed:

* [Jira](https://demo.frigade.com/?skill=jira)
* [Spotify](https://demo.frigade.com/?skill=spotify)
* [Hacker News](https://demo.frigade.com/?skill=hackernews)

**Frigade is best for:**

* Teams drowning in "how do I..." tickets
* CS teams who want [onboarding](https://productonboarding.com/articles/what-is-product-onboarding) to happen without a call
* Product teams who want every feature to be [self-serve](https://productonboarding.com/examples)
* Anyone with a complex product or non-technical users who keep getting stuck

Many teams are also building their own agents in-house. If that's you, we're launching the Frigade API soon so you can add our generative assistance capabilities into your agent. More on that soon.

If your product's complex or your users aren't super technical, we'd love to show you what Frigade does on your actual app. Send us a note, or book a demo at [frigade.com](http://frigade.com).

Eric & Christian
