launches.title: Lune AI - Better LLMs for code and technical tasks
launches.tagline: A replacement to standard LLMs for coding tasks - eliminate hallucinations with a marketplace of expert LLMs trained on hundreds of technical topics.
launches.body:
[ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iPCixKBJiZI)

Hey everyone! We’re Sam and Josh, and we’re building a platform for better LLMs for code and technical tasks.

## **TLDR:**

[Lune AI](https://www.lune.dev/) is a platform to find and train Lunes, or expert LLMs on any technical topic for code. We outperform the accuracy of standalone foundational models by [37%](https://www.lune.dev/blog/lune-evaluation).

Here’s a [**demo**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zwokp23C3ek):

## **The Problem:**

LLMs **hallucinate** on material outside their training data, which often leads to inaccurate answers to technical questions related to code. Whether it’s working with a new library, or the ever changing nature of software documentation, every developer has **wasted time** on hallucinated LLM outputs.

## **Lune Web:**

On Lune Web, users can find a [marketplace](https://chat.lune.dev/explore) of community trained Lunes on **hundreds** of the most popular libraries and Github repositories for developers. In a concept similar to OpenAI’s GPT store, users that train popular Lunes receive monthly payouts in a **revenue share program**.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85640&key=user_uploads/1758131/9b8e2428-b02e-4247-a5bc-f8746504e7f1)

When interacting with Lunes on the web, users can also **receive payouts** for leaving feedback on Lune performance and contributing their own expertise to specific Lunes. This direct community driven feedback loop continuously improves the accuracy of our models.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85640&key=user_uploads/1758131/0a27c84c-44d0-477a-a4db-3d3ccf8c6da1)

## **Lune API:**

In addition to Lune Web, we offer API access to our proprietary automatic context switching model, Tycho as well as all public Lunes. Tycho is our context switching model that **automatically determines** the right Lunes to retrieve information from given a user query, in order to provide the most accurate answer. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85640&key=user_uploads/1758131/0fb0ab51-5d7c-4578-8174-21d5e9563ff0)

Our API is hot swappable with OpenAI, which means our users can [integrate](https://docs.lune.dev/docs/external-integrations/cursor) Tycho into any IDE, tool, or client that **supports OpenAI compatible APIs** with a personal API key, such as Cursor, Continue, and other AI client SDKs.

launches.title: Friday - Never check your email again
launches.tagline: Offload all of your emails to your AI virtual assistant.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're Allen and Advait from Friday and we are using AI to help you reduce your email inbox to only the most essential emails, teaching your assistant how to handle the rest.\
\
**TLDR:** Email sucks, and takes forever. Most of your emails don’t require you to personally handle them. So, like a human assistant, Friday will draft responses, perform outreach and follow up, text you when you get urgent emails, get rid of clutter, and more, so you can focus on the dozen or so actually important emails in your inbox.

Friday is meant for anyone who would benefit from having an assistant manage their inbox. If you want to automate 99% of your emails, [try Friday](https://www.fridaymail.ai/) right now!\
<https://youtu.be/2Dq11hlJhqs>

### **The Problem:**

Email sucks. You either spend hours dealing with all the emails in your inbox, or you ignore them.

It takes forever, and hiring a human assistant is costly and introduces privacy concerns.

### **The Insight:**

The reality is that almost all of the emails you receive resemble emails that you have dealt with before.

So, you can just tell an AI what kind of emails you get, and tell it exactly how to handle those emails, and it can just do it for you.

Now, you only have to deal with the important, fun, or unique emails, forever eliminating the chore of going through your inbox.

### **The Solution:**

# **Smart Inbox**

You can tell Friday the kinds of emails you get using natural language, and then define actions that Friday should take once those emails come in.

For example:

* When you get an investor email, Friday gives personalized answers to their questions and sends them a meeting link.
* If a customer has an urgent request, have Friday text you so you can respond to them immediately.
* Follow up with clients that take forever to answer their email, until they respond (they should use Friday).
* If you get customer support emails, Friday answers their questions based on its memories and forwards the interaction to your cofounder.
* Summarize all the notifications from GitHub, Linear, Google, etc., and then archive those emails
* Whenever you get a new customer, Friday can search the web and write a personalized email to all of them, answering any questions they may have, immediately
* And so much more!

Just take a look at your inbox, see the emails that aren’t extremely important, and let Friday handle those emails from now on, so your inbox is left with the 5 emails a day that you want to personally handle.

# **Personal Assistant**

Friday also lets you chat with your personal assistant. You can have it reply to emails, check your inbox, send out personalized outbound, and more!

For example, if you wanted a meeting with Garry, you could ask Friday to go through your previous email history with Garry, perform a web search to learn more about Garry, and using what it knows about you, write a personalized email to him.

You can give it a dozen names or emails, and it’ll do research and write personalized emails to all of them that can be approved and sent out with a single message.

Getting this right is difficult, so everyone else settles with trying to help you go through your email twice as fast. If you want to go 100x as fast, you shouldn't spend even a second on useless emails.

### **Our Ask:**

**This product is meant for anyone who would benefit from having an assistant manage their inbox. If you want to automate 99% of your emails, **[**try Friday**](https://www.fridaymail.ai/)** right now!**

**Happy Friday!**

Hey YC!

We’re Shaunak and Rahul and we are making it easy for developers to **integrate AI Agents into any software application**. We do this by making agents available as simple APIs that can be called from anywhere. Developers have used Truffle to add customer support agents into WhatsApp and integrate analytics agents into Slack. Check out our demo below 👇

<https://youtu.be/5tEuWYWNSPA>

### **The Problem**

While AI models have become more accessible, getting AI agents to production remains painfully complex. Developers don’t just need a model—they need to handle:

* Managing state, memory, and vector databases
* Manually integrating external tools and APIs
* Customizing agents for specific business logic
* Setting up and maintaining deployment infrastructure

Despite existing frameworks, **developers still spend 60% of their time on "glue code" instead of building actual AI solutions**. Companies burn **$100K–$200K per year** on DevOps overhead, just to manage AI agent infrastructure. AI should be easier to integrate than this.

### **The Solution**

Truffle AI eliminates infrastructure headaches by turning AI agents into plug-and-play APIs:

* **No infrastructure setup** - Our managed service handles the heavy lifting, eliminating deployment and scaling concerns
* **Seamless integration** - Add AI agents to any application with just a few lines of code
* **Full customization** - Build agents tailored to your specific business challenges
* **Reusability** - Deploy the same agents across multiple applications

Most AI adoption today is being held back by engineering complexity—Truffle AI removes that bottleneck, making AI agents as simple to integrate as calling an API.

### **Our Story**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88053&key=user_uploads/1684384/164d65b8-6f92-4bc5-809d-a82b0c99c029)

As developers, we both hit the same frustrating wall: spending countless hours writing "glue code" for infrastructure instead of building innovative AI solutions.

While exploring several frameworks to build AI agents, we discovered a critical gap - none addressed the massive infrastructure overhead required for production-ready AI systems.

With Rahul's expertise in large-scale deployment and cluster management at AWS and Shaunak's background in AI research and product development, we realized we were uniquely positioned to solve this problem.

Our mission became clear: make powerful AI accessible to businesses of all sizes by eliminating the infrastructure barriers that slow innovation.

### **Who Is This For?**

👩‍💻 **Software developers** who want to add AI capabilities without becoming infrastructure experts\
🏢 **Startups and enterprises** looking to quickly deploy AI solutions without hiring specialized DevOps teams\
🔧 **AI engineers** who want to focus on agent design rather than deployment pipelines\
🛠️ **Product teams** who need to iterate rapidly on AI features without getting bogged down in infrastructure

With Truffle AI, developers have already built:

💬 Customer support agents that automate WhatsApp & Slack interactions

🤖 Multi-agent workflows that coordinate different AI tasks seamlessly

launches.title: G LNK - Simplifying collaboration between Pharma & Healthcare professionals
launches.tagline: Meet G LNK, the AI one-stop shop for all medical interactions
launches.body:
Hey YC!

We’re [Raouf](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2360566) and [Rayan](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2366179) — co-founders of G LNK

**TL;DR**

G LNK is an AI-powered platform that connects Pharma companies with doctors & researchers. Rayan worked on this as a consultant, where Pharma companies spent billions annually just to determine how much to pay doctors while staying within regulatory guidelines. Using LLMs, we’re automating the end-to-end process—from identifying candidates to compensation and compliance.\
<https://youtu.be/16oP6roNnZk>

**Problem**

Pharma companies spend over **$70 billion annually** on engaging doctors & researchers, yet a lot of that money is wasted on outdated and manual processes:

* **Outsourcing is expensive and slow**: Companies spend millions on third parties (consulting, recruiting, and regulatory firms)  just to find the right experts and to know how much to pay them compliantly.
* **Compliance risks are high**: Payment miscalculations can lead to regulatory violations and hefty fines
* **Data is scattered**: Contracts, payments and compliance tracking are spread across disconnected systems, making transparency and oversight difficult

<https://youtu.be/qDdFbMWO6eU>

**Solution**

**G LNK automates Pharma companies' entire healthcare professional (HCP) engagement process**—from identifying suitable doctors to engaging them. Here’s how it works:

1. **Identify HCPs:**
   * Identify a doctor from our database of over 3.2 million user profiles (growing 250% MoM).
   * Alternatively, if you know who you want to engage, simply upload the doctor’s CV and we will take care of the rest.
2. **Calculate Compensation:**
   * Instantly determine their compensation rates.
   * Adjust the rates dynamically based on factors such as service type and travel requirements.
3. **Engage Directly:**
   * Contact the selected doctors directly through our platform.
4. **Ensure Compliance:**
   * Maintain regulatory compliance and prevent compliance violations before they happen.
   * Leverage real-time data from trusted sources like NIH, PubMed, CBS, CMS, and more.

This step-by-step solution replaces multiple vendors with a single AI-powered platform, ensuring efficient, compliant, and cost-effective HCP engagement.

**Additional Features**

* **Built-in CRM** to track all HCP engagements
* **Comprehensive financial tracking**, including:
  * All Transfer of Value payments made to HCPs (date, purpose, associated drug)
  * Drug coverage breakdown
  * Monthly payment summaries
  * Payment analysis by Therapeutic Area
* **Tailored recommendations** for grants, conferences, and publications for HCPs
* **Centralized database** of regulations and Codes of Conduct across 150+ countries

**Team**

Rayan and Raouf have known each other for over a decade, with their professional relationship cementing itself during their time as researchers at the University of Chicago.

**Rayan (CEO)** worked as a Life-Sciences Consultant at PwC and was recognized as top consulting analyst in the US for pioneering automation in pharmaceutical compliance. He holds degrees in Chemistry & Economics at UChicago, where he was one of the youngest biochemistry researchers at Pritzker School of Engineering.

**Raouf (CTO)** worked as a ML-researcher at AxLab, where he specialized in developing neural network architectures for multimodal human-computer interaction with adaptive reinforcement learning. He has a multidisciplinary background, with degrees in Computer Science, Astrophysics, & Economics from UChicago

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88235&key=user_uploads/2366179/8a3b2573-1a0d-499b-b252-94260eb9ca1d)

**We are on a mission to help Pharma companies cut costs, enhance accuracy with better benchmarking, and save valuable time. By streamlining these critical processes, we empower Pharma to focus more resources on manufacturing, distribution, and supply—accelerating the delivery of life-changing treatments to those who need them most.**

**Our Asks**

We would really appreciate introductions to anyone working in the Pharma industry or any health-related verticals. Additionally, if you know any physician/research communities, we would love to talk and learn more!

launches.body:
Hi YC! I’m Simon, building **assistant-ui**, an open source Typescript/React library for AI chat.

Hundreds of projects use assistant-ui to build in-app AI assistants, including companies like:

![Logos of LangChain, AthenaIntelligence, Browser Use, Stack AI](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/d3eda556-de8c-4404-b4be-c0295f9aeb8e)

With >50k+ monthly downloads, assistant-ui is the most popular UI library for AI chat.

## **Getting Started**

You can get started by running **\`npx assistant-ui create\`** (new project) or **\`npx assistant-ui init\`** (existing project) in your terminal.

![Gif showing the setup process, which takes under 30 seconds](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/17c78ae1-d8cf-4fc4-a8aa-056fe449da02)

## **Features**

* **Pre-built components**, fully customizable
* **Connects to your backend**
  * We have first class integration for **AI SDK** and **LangGraph** or build your own
* **Generative UI**: Map LLM tool calls and JSONs to custom UI components
* **Frontend Tool Calls:** Let LLMs take action in your frontend app
* **Human Tool Calls:** Human approvals and input collection
* **Chat history and analytics** via assistant-cloud (the hosted offering)

## **Customization**

The API of assistant-ui is inspired by libraries like **Radix UI** and **cmdk**. Instead of a single monolithic chat component, we give you composable primitives and a great starter configuration. You have full control over the look and feel of every pixel while leaving auto-scrolling, LLM streaming and accessibility to us.

![Photo showing the modular component structure. ComposerPrimitive.Input is the chat input field, ComposerPrimitive.Send is the send button.](/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/d8eacc69-2d94-4c43-8fab-2dcac5e7f029)

Sample customization to make a perplexity lookalike:

![Perplexity lookalike Chat UI](/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/16e96ae2-d563-4f6c-9047-6c3485a1cb3d)

## **Demo Video**

[Demo Video](https://youtu.be/9eLKs9AM4tU?si=jm9GzoFAcyM_tPT-)

## **About**

I’ve wanted to build my own dev tool company since high school. Last year, I built the first version of assistant-ui because I needed the UX of ChatGPT in my own app. The app I was building didn’t work out, but few friends asked me about the chat UI. Since then, AI chat has became increasingly popular as a means for delegating tasks to AI agents. My focus is on enabling human <> agent collaboration through better UX and AX (agent experience).

![Photo of Simon, the founder](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/d43c8332-b160-40d8-8f27-849bd82806e3)

## **Ask**

* [Join our Discord](https://discord.com/invite/S9dwgCNEFs)

launches.body:
**Industrial Sales teams are underwater. Here’s why - and what we’re doing to fix it.**

Hi everyone! We’re [Smit](https://www.linkedin.com/in/smitdagli/) and [Vik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vikhyath-m-a00357128/) - the founders of [Kanava AI](https://kanava.ai/)

**Problem and Opportunity:**

The wholesale distribution industry is massive: _$9T+ in annual revenue. 410,000+ businesses. 6 million+ employees._

And yet — sales teams are drowning.

* **A third of the workforce is over 55**, and replacements aren’t coming fast enough.

  (“Most of my sales reps are **retiring in the next 2-3 years**, I have **NO idea** what I’ll do after” - a medium sized electrical goods distributor from Indiana we met)
* **Reps spend less than 30% of their time selling**. The rest? Answering repetitive calls (“What’s the price of this SKU?” “Which warehouse has it?”), digging through systems, and manual follow-ups.
* **Over 25% of inbound calls never reach a human** — lost revenue, lost trust, lost time.

This isn’t just inefficiency. It’s operational drag at scale — and it's only getting worse.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s1NVVxRnLL8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s1NVVxRnLL8%5C%5C)

**How’re we solving it:**

We’re building Kanava AI, a voice-based AI agent designed for wholesale distributors.

It handles repetitive tasks like **answering stock, price,** and **order status calls** using live **ERP** data and logging **field notes hands-free**, drafting follow-ups, updating the **CRM** all _automatically_.

It’s like a junior rep-in-training. It starts with the basics, but improves quickly by learning from the company’s best performers. Over time, Kanava takes on more:

•⁠ **⁠Managing consultative sales calls** \
•⁠ ⁠**Identifying upsell opportunities** in real time \
•⁠ ⁠**Surfacing coaching insights** from rep conversations \
•⁠ ⁠**Re-engaging dormant accounts** with timely, data-backed outreach

And by the time these reps are ready to retire, Kanava is **ready to fill the void they leave.**

Most AI tools in this space fail because they try to do too much, too early, and distributors are famously late adopters. We’re taking a more deliberate path: start with low-leverage work, prove value, and scale responsibility as the system earns it.

**Our Team**

Vik (CTO) and Smit (CEO) know each other since freshman year of college at UC Berkeley. Both of us studied CS, and worked as AI engineers at various startups before deciding to build our own thing and join YC.

**Smit:** Built incident resolution agents at a series B observability startup called Observe. Previously worked at Abnormal Security and Salesforce.

**Vik**: Built voice agents for numerical data entry and hands-free navigation for a data management platform called Uncountable. Previously worked at Uber and Amazon.

We’re both outsiders to the wholesale distribution industry, but we’re listening hard and learning fast.

What made us really want to work together was being on the same ultimate frisbee team in the senior year of college - that team was a disaster, we lost every single game we played by huge margins, but despite that, we had a ton of fun and stuck together!

**Our Ask** If you know any **distributors, field sales heavy businesses or IMR’s (Independent Manufacturer Reps)**, we’d appreciate a connection at [smit@kanava.ai](mailto:smit@kanava.ai) or [vikhyath@kanava.ai](mailto:vikhyath@kanava.ai). We’ll make their lives a lot easier and buy you a coffee ☕🤎

**What is Zero and how does it work?**

Zero makes email work for you, not the other way around (checkout our launch video below!).

[Launch Video](https://youtu.be/3Hy3jEQQVFQ)

Zero uses AI to:

* **Prioritize** emails and surface what matters most
* **Summarize** long email threads into quick takeaways
* **Draft** and **Reply** to emails automatically
* **Organize** your inbox into smart categories, let you chat with your inbox, understand projects, and plan your day.

Traditional email clients are outdated and passive. They overload you with notifications, bury important messages, and force you to manually manage threads, tasks, and follow-ups. Meanwhile, most “AI” email tools are just bolt-on features, slow, clunky, and unaware of the full context of your inbox.

**Our Solution**\
Zero is built from the ground up as an **AI-native email platform**. That means every part of your experience, from prioritization to replies, is powered by a deep understanding of your inbox and your workflow. Zero doesn’t just help you **handle** email, it helps you get **ahead** of it.

* AI that thinks like a human assistant, not a search algorithm
* Real-time summaries and smart organization that adapts to your day
* A seamless way to interact with your email through natural conversation
* Fully open source for complete transparency

Slashy can do everything from writing drafts in your tone, texting you when an important email comes in, prepping you for calls, to the things you expect from a true email client like keyboard shortcuts, open tracking, a mobile app and more. You can get started for free at [slashy.com](http://slashy.com), and use our YC deal for a long-term discount.

Most founders we speak to, have one of two problems (sometimes both)

1. They spend too much time manually handling email, and not enough building their company.
2. They don’t spend enough time on email, and lose important deals/hires due to things slipping.

## **Solution**

That’s why we built Slashy, the first email platform that reliably gets work done for you, whether it be drafting emails, notifying you when a prospect replies, schedule meetings, or more. Slashy works wherever you work best, so onboarding is seamless (just ask some of our users). It takes 10 minutes to set up, and saves the average email power user an extra one hour a day. It does this by:

1. **Doing all the basic things right:** Stuff like keyboard shortcuts, open tracking, unified inbox, team comments, availability links, all come part of Slashy. So you don’t lose anything transitioning from Gmail, Superhuman, Front and more. ([@Jayme Hoffman](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/60463) actually switched to Slashy being surprised just that a new email client could match the speed, shortcuts of something like Superhuman)
2. **Writing drafts that sound like you:** Claude drafts sound like slop because they just look at the thread. Slashy does a lot more, it looks at the linkedin/web of recipients, past emails you’ve sent, past changes you’ve made to prior drafts, and more including using our own custom-built memory system for email. (Fun fact we have a special tool for handling suggesting times/scheduling as base llms are very bad at this). ([@Michelle Marcelline](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/379052) pretty much just hits send on all her Slashy drafts with minimal edits)
3. **A powerful sidebar:** Slashy comes with a cursor-like sidebar. That lets you do things like search, draft, schedule and more. So you no longer need to keep flipping between ChatGPT and your email. ([@Yahia Bakour](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2538368) loves this to power thorugh drafts and replies)
4. **Integrations:** Slashy connects to not just your email, but your meeting notes (Granola, Fathom, Circleback, etc.), crm (Attio, Hubspot, Salesforce, etc.), Notion and more since the context to handle email isn’t just in email. ([@Pavlos Markesinis](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2511438) loves how Slashy connects to his Attio and makes life simple)
5. **Automations:** The best assistants also know when to handle things in the background. So Slashy can also automatically do things like prep you for calls, text you when an important email comes in, and more. ([@Owen Botkin](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2579867) relies on Slashy to prep him from calls, and [@Pranav Madhukar](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1531197) doesn’t even check his email anymore unless Slashy alerts him an email comes in)
6. **iMessage/Slack Bot:** One of the worst parts of traditional clients? You need to open them to see if something important comes in. Slashy can ping you on text/slack so you don’t even need to context switch. (@devansh is one of our bigger Slack fans, while [@Abhinav Gopal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/979064) for iMessage).
7. **Voice:** Sometimes it’s easier to speak your mind than write (or you’re driving and just can’t haha). So Slashy lets you dictate your thoughts, and our AI will make it sound like a much better version of you. Or you can talk with our voice to voice agent when you’re commuting (@vishruth is one of our power users for our voice drafts).
8. **Personalized Memory:** Slashy gets better the more you use it. It keeps notes on how you write, who you talk to, when you schedule, and also it learns from every edit you made before hitting send. It even once a week goes back and rewrites its notes to better match you. After all you'd expect a human assistant to be smarter after a few months, why not your ai one. ([@Devraj Gopal](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2057015) loves how Slashy has grown to know him more and more).
9. **Natural Language Labels:** A common complaint we hear is the rise of the AI SDR, and how everyone’s inbox is inundated with emails. The problem with traditional labelling systems is they don’t adjust over time, leading to important emails getting missed. Slashy’s labelling system does, leading to a much better filtering rate, and fewer dropped balls. ([@Nazli Danis](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/520906) was drowning in spam before Slashy)

## Security and Privacy

We take security/privacy as an email client very seriously.  We’ve already gotten CASA, and SOC II. We also get monthly pen-tests done by [@Casco](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/30477) to ensure our users' data is safe. None of our AI providers train on your data as well.

## Getting Started

Now if you want to get started just go to[ slashy.com](http://slashy.com), or you can book a time here if you’d like me to demo the product/ask any questions just shoot an email to [founders+ea@slashy.com](mailto:founders+ea@slashy.com), and Slashy will schedule a time that works for both of us :)

launches.title: Whispering: Local-First, Open-Source Speech to Text at Your Fingertips
launches.tagline: Own your data. Use any model you want. Free and open source.❤️
launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋 It's Braden, and I'm excited to introduce Whispering—a fully open-source, local-first speech-to-text app, and the first app in the Epicenter ecosystem. You can [give it a star](http://go.epicenter.so/github), install it [here](https://go.epicenter.so/install/whispering), and start using it today.

I use Whispering multiple hours daily for voice coding, writing, and thinking out loud. I churned from Wispr Flow and Superwhisper after I built it.

I think the ergonomics are quite delightful, and I hope you will too!

[Voice coding workflow](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tpix588SeiQ)

## **The Problem**

You use a transcription app, but you have no idea what happens to your data.

They’re not open-source. They might call themselves “local” or say “inference stays on device”—but you still can’t see the code. It’s a black box, and for all you know, _you’re the product_.

Your voice recordings might be sitting on their servers and sold to other providers. You're locked into their ecosystem. When they pivot, get acquired, or shut down, your workflow will break.

Many “AI transcription” startups are just API or local inference wrappers with subscription pricing. You speak into their app, they send your audio to a transcription API like Whisper, then charge you monthly for what you could run yourself. Some run locally, but none I found were open-source with the UX I needed.

## **The Solution**

Truly free and open-source transcription software that matches (or surpasses) the ergonomics of paid, closed-software alternatives. I think Whispering is now at that stage.

## **What makes us different:**

There are many other applications in the transcription landscape. Whispering offers some notable features:

* **Hands-free, voice-activated dictation**: One of our most ergonomic features so far. Press once to start the session, and it will automatically start and stop as you speak. No button-holding or toggling nonsense. Perfect for dictating when your hands are full
* **Custom AI transformations with any prompt, any model:** Design custom transformations that chain multiple AI models to fix grammar, translate, or refactor your transcribed text
* **Unbeatable price:**  Nothing beats free. If you bring an API key from [Groq Cloud](https://console.groq.com/keys), you’ll get nearly instantaneous transcription at $0.04/hour plus a generous free tier. And of course, if you run locally with Speeches, it’s completely free. We hope to expand our models soon.
* **Open-source**: MIT licensed. Fork it, examine it, roast it. We pride ourselves in our code quality.
* **Everything is local-first**: In Whispering, everything is local-first. Recordings are stored in IndexedDB, and settings are stored in local storage. Built with Svelte 5 and Tauri, and it's tiny (\~22MB) and fast.

## **Real Daily Usage**

* **Talking to Claude in my room** (3-4 hrs/day): I use dictation to prompt Claude Code significantly faster than typing. I have a custom post-processing transformation set up so that every text blob that I dictate is passed through a Gemini 2.5 Flash prompt, making the output more Claude-Code-friendly (bullet points, etc.). Once done, I paste into Claude Code.
* **While carrying pizza boxes back from the Y Combinator office:** My hands are full, so I’ll open the web app on my phone, turn on voice activated dictation, and then start yapping as thoughts come up. The words are waiting when I get back in my room
* **Other custom transformations**: I have a common writing workflow of speech → Transcribe (Groq) → Fix Grammar (Claude 4 Sonnet) → Format (Gemini 2.5 Flash).

## **Why This Matters**

Fundamental tools shouldn’t require trusting a black box. And they shouldn’t charge you rent for something you could run yourself.

We believe productivity apps should be open-source and transparent with your data, and we want to destroy their business models with open-source alternatives.

These alternatives will need to match them feature-by-feature, have a great UX, and eventually, be built on top of our shared memory layer.

## **Where This Is Going**

Whispering is the first app in the Epicenter ecosystem: local-first, open-source tools built on top of a shared memory of plain text and SQLite. We hope to replace siloed, data-driven tools with local-first alternatives that share a single, user-owned memory layer.

We also hope to support many more offline models over time, giving you maximum flexibility in how and where your data is processed.

We’re not stopping at transcription. While most transcription apps tinker with static dictionaries or custom word lists, our eventual goal with Epicenter is to leverage that shared memory. We could connect transcription to everything you think, write, and build, all within a trustworthy, local-first environment.

Whispering would pick up your common phrases, technical terms, and more. Over time, you create custom transformation pipelines that adapt to your writing style, your voice, and your world.

## **Our Ask**

* 🌟 [**Upvote on Product Hunt**](https://www.producthunt.com/products/whispering?launch=whispering). Help others discover open-source alternatives
* 💻[ **Download the desktop app**](https://go.epicenter.so/install-whispering) from our [installation guide](https://go.epicenter.so/install/whispering), or directly from our latest [releases](https://github.com/epicenter-so/epicenter/releases)
* ⭐ [**Star on GitHub**](https://github.com/epicenter-so/epicenter/tree/main/apps/whispering). Back local-first software. Fork it, break it, improve it. Everything’s MIT licensed. Copy whatever you want.
* 💬 [**Join our Discord**](https://go.epicenter.so/discord). Shape what we build next

Try it, and let us know what’s up. I hope Whispering becomes a part of your workflow!

[Full Setup Guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1jYgBMrfVZs)

Hey everyone! 👋 It’s[ Braden](https://www.linkedin.com/in/braden-wong/), and I’m building Epicenter.

Epicenter is an open-source suite of tools built around a single idea:

**Creativity thrives when you blur the lines between disciplines.**

Your tools should reflect that. Most tools divide you—one for writing, one for planning, one for research. We’re building tools that talk to each other—so you can stay in flow across every kind of work. 

Epicenter will be a growing software ecosystem—a text editor, a CRM, a personal assistant, and more—all built around a shared local memory.

**The problem**

Modern knowledge work is fragmented.

I journal into an app I don’t trust. I plan my week in a calendar app I’ll abandon next month. My notes drift aimlessly in systems I’ve outgrown. And every time I switch apps, the app forgets what I was working on.

Notes, code, and ideas live in isolated tools that don’t talk to each other, breaking flow and burying context.

**The solution**

A suite of open-source tools that share a single memory: a folder on your machine. Open-source, open-format, and fully yours.

The tools share so you can make connections across disciplines. Your ideas and data are never locked in.

[**epicenter.sh**](http://epicenter.sh)

I just launched [epicenter.sh](http://epicenter.sh): a local-first assistant you can chat with. It lives in a folder, and we want to make it the access point to everything you’ve ever written, thought, or built.

[epicenter.sh](http://epicenter.sh) is the first addition to Epicenter. This is your new shell: your second brain becomes your dialogue partner. You type; it thinks. You ask; it searches. Under the hood, it’s powered by a modified version of [Opencode](https://github.com/sst/opencode), an excellent open-source coding agent. We’ve made our own CLI and UI to simplify configuration and the user experience. It’s rough around the edges, but it’s our first step in laying the foundation for our future applications.

**Where We’re Headed**

In a world where every app wants to trap you and your data, we’re building the opposite.

Epicenter is open-source, local-first, and plain-text native—so you can trust it, tweak it, or take it with you. We’re building tools that support intentional, interdisciplinary thinking: software for people who read, write, build, and connect.

A renaissance workflow, built on plain text and real ownership.

**Our Ask**

We’re early. But if you think like a generalist, build like a hacker, and value tools that respect your mind—we’d love to hear from you.

launches.title: Omnara: The API for Production-Ready agents
launches.tagline: Open-source alternative to claude managed agents
launches.body:
Omnara is an open-source platform for creating and interacting with production-ready agents via an API, without having to worry about the tedious parts of managing an agent control plane. It’s an open-source alternative to Claude Managed Agents, Langchain Managed Agents, Vercel Eve, etc.

## **Problem:**

---

Building agents is hard. Many companies are building agent control planes, both for internal use and external use. The common pattern is you use some local agent framework, like claude agent sdk, mastra, langchain, or your own loop, host that on VMs/kubernetes/workers, expose an API with endpoints to interact with agents, handle machine failures, resumption of an agent, provisioning sandbox environments so those agents can code, configure endpoints to add skills and MCPs, have user message tracking, audit logs, and on and on.

It’s a lot of infrastructure work that has nothing to do with what the agent actually does. And most teams end up having to build and maintain their own versions of it.

Omnara is that layer. It provides this infrastructure for you. So you can create and interact with your agents through a standard API without having to worry about building and maintaining your own control plane.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112080&key=user_uploads/1391601/7b5a0575-9a32-4af8-966f-9b6370e74edc)

## **Bring your own computer:**

Run this on any linux or macOS machine (windows coming soon): \
**curl -fsSL https://app.omnara.com/install/omnarad.sh | sh**\
It connects the machine to the Omnara control plane. You can then give any agent access to this machine. This allows you to spin up an EC2 instance and have your agents use that as a persistent machine, or even run it on your macbook so that cloud agents can directly edit files locally when it’s online. You can also bring your own sandbox provider API keys (currently we support Blaxel, Daytona, and Unikraft).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112080&key=user_uploads/1391601/55bd57b2-62f9-414e-8acc-405797264d3a)

## **Bring your own model:**

Omnara allows you to bring your own LLM endpoint and API key (we support OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Completions, and Anthropic Messages formats, with more coming soon). You can use your hundreds of thousands of free LLM credits from YC in Omnara!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=112080&key=user_uploads/1391601/12802420-8c49-4609-bd5c-9b7df94954f6)

---

Because you can bring your own machine and models, you can use Omnara for completely free! Our architecture allows us to efficiently host hundreds of millions of agents on minimal hardware, so we can easily eat that cost.

If you prefer our hosted models (via openrouter) and hosted sandboxes (via blaxel), we're giving $1,000 in credits to the first 50 teams building on Omnara. Email us at [**contact@omnara.com**](mailto:contact@omnara.com) with what you're building and we’ll apply the credits to your organization.

If you want help self-hosting the control plane or running it in your VPC/on-prem, we’re taking on five design partners. Email [**ishaan@omnara.com**](mailto:ishaan@omnara.com).

Website: [**omnara.com**](http://omnara.com) \
App: [**app.omnara.com**](http://app.omnara.com) \
Docs: [**docs.omnara.com**](http://docs.omnara.com) \
Source: [**github.com/omnara-ai/omnara**](http://github.com/omnara-ai/omnara)

launches.title: Omnara: Run Claude Code from Anywhere 🤖
launches.tagline: Stay involved with your coding agents without being at your desk
launches.body:
We’re Ishaan and Kartik, and we’re building **Omnara**, a web and mobile interface for Claude Code that lets you keep coding agents moving even when you’re away from your desk.

🎥 Demo:[ https://x.com/i/status/2014383431845839186](https://x.com/i/status/2014383431845839186)

## **❌ The Problem**

Coding agents can work independently for long stretches, but they still block on human input.

If an agent needs clarification while you’re away, everything pauses.\
If your laptop sleeps, long-running work stops.\
Most remote agent tools run in hosted environments instead of where your code actually lives.

Agents should fit around your schedule, not the other way around.

## **🛠️ The Solution**

**Omnara makes working with coding agents feel continuous instead of fragile.**

You can:

* Start agents locally and stay involved from anywhere using web or mobile
* Keep work moving even if your laptop goes offline
* Talk to agents using voice when typing isn’t convenient

## **🔒 Run agents in your environment, access them from anywhere**

With Omnara, your coding agent runs on your own machine, whether that’s your laptop or a remote VM you control.

You can access and interact with that agent from anywhere, securely, without SSH, port forwarding, or tunneling.

Your agent runs in your real environment, but you’re not tied to the machine it’s running on.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97081&key=user_uploads/2661368/81388baf-658a-4c43-94ac-1ce4e17a1605)

## **☁️ Keep agents running when your machine is off**

Agents shouldn’t stop just because your laptop does.

If your machine goes offline, Omnara can keep the agent running in the cloud so work continues. You can still interact from web or mobile, and when you’re back at your desk, you can pick up where things left off.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97081&key=user_uploads/2661368/098a8bf1-046d-4362-86b2-63d984e999dd)

## **🎙️ Talk to your coding agent**

Mobile typing works for quick replies, but it’s not great for longer back and forth.

Omnara includes voice so you can talk to your coding agent when typing isn’t convenient. Speaking tends to provide more context and makes it easier to iterate, especially while walking or multitasking.

launches.title: Omnara - The first command center for AI agents: terminal, web, and mobile
launches.tagline: Run Claude Code from anywhere and switch seamlessly between devices
launches.body:
https://www.loom.com/share/03d30efcf8e44035af03cbfebf840c73

Start Claude Code in the terminal, then pick it up instantly on web or mobile with a seamless handoff between all three

### The Problem

Claude Code is incredible, but it chains you to your desk.\
Once an agent starts working, you’re stuck waiting in the terminal for it to ask you something. That could take 5–10 minutes, and if you’re away, progress halts. We’ve coded from our beds, on walks, in Ubers, while doing laundry… and yes, even on the toilet — but only after we built Omnara.

Existing solutions don’t solve this well:

* **Other Claude Code wrappers** (e.g., Crystal, Conductor) often replace the native experience but don’t let you jump between terminal, web, and mobile.
* **Terminal replication tools** (e.g., Vibetunnel, Termius) let you SSH in, but have no push notifications, clean diffs, or simple setup.

### What’s Omnara?

Omnara is the **first agent command center** — start an AI agent in the terminal, then continue the same session from our web dashboard or mobile app.

With Omnara, you can:

* Launch agents from terminal, web, or mobile.
* Switch between them instantly.
* Get **real-time push notifications** when agents need your input.
* Review logs, see Git diffs, and approve/reject changes with one tap.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93029&key=user_uploads/1391601/bf61f9ae-4f37-4377-90c8-fc2bed1d0866)

**How it works**\
We built a CLI wrapper that mirrors the native Claude Code experience — output, permissions, notifications, and mode switching — by parsing the session file at _\~/.claude/projects_ and terminal output in real time. All agent and user messages are streamed via SSE to the Omnara platform, where you can respond from anywhere.

It’s fully open source: [github.com/omnara-ai/omnara](https://github.com/omnara-ai/omnara)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93029&key=user_uploads/1391601/837e9af0-e038-4bb1-9f1c-1ebf152f8157)

### Why launch with Claude Code first?

Omnara works with any AI agent, but Claude Code users immediately “get” the value. It’s the perfect human-in-the-loop use case — and the one we use every day.

We’ve also used Omnara as a human-in-the-loop node in n8n workflows, e.g., for replying to emails. This is just the beginning.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93029&key=user_uploads/1391601/96e585a6-db46-4a20-8901-0ddbc7e409cf)

### Pricing

Free for up to 10 agent sessions/month.\
$9/month for unlimited.

### About Us

We’re **Ishaan & Kartik**, childhood friends since Montessori. We’ve spent years working in AI and AI infra at big tech and acquired startups and love building tools that remove friction for developers.

### Try it free

`pip install omnara && omnara`Then log in at [omnara.com](http://omnara.com) or download our iOS app: [Omnara on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/omnara-ai-command-center/id674...)

launches.tagline: Changing how people work across their computer and apps with voice
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Connor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/connor-waslo/) and [Rajiv](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rajivsancheti/).

We led Loom’s AI suite and saw firsthand how natural language was changing how people work. Now we’re building Caddy, the voice interface for your computer that lets you automate work across all your apps.

Join the waitlist at [trycaddy.ai](http://trycaddy.ai)

**Launch video:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v1HwM9mBYHU

### **The problem**

Work today happens across a maze of apps. Slack for messaging. Linear for tickets. Gmail for communication. Calendar for scheduling. Every task requires jumping between tabs and tools.

Even with AI everywhere, we are still using the same old interfaces. Voice assistants like Siri or Alexa can answer trivia but cannot do real work. They do not understand what is on your screen, what app you are in, or what you mean when you say “follow up on this.”

The result is constant context switching, lost flow, and hours wasted on work that should happen automatically.

### **What we are building**

Caddy lives on your desktop and lets you operate your computer with your voice. It has two simple modes.

**Action mode:** You speak your intent, and Caddy takes action.

Ask Caddy to create a ticket in Linear, send a message in Slack, or schedule a meeting in Calendar. Caddy sees what is on your screen and connects it to your apps, so you can stay focused on the work that matters.

**Dictation mode:** Never type again

Write emails, respond to messages, or leave comments anywhere text input exists. It is a direct replacement for typing that works globally across your computer.

Together, these two modes let you automate work and control your computer completely with your voice.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95249&key=user_uploads/2945950/d99dbe1c-8793-4405-a7ca-568f05c831fd)

### **Who Caddy is for**

We are starting with founders, operators, productivity power users and the voice first generation who spend their days moving between tools and losing time to repetitive work. If that sounds like you, we would love to get you early access.

To join our waitlist add your email at [trycaddy.ai](http://trycaddy.ai) or shoot us a message [founders@trycaddy.ai](mailto:founders@trycaddy.ai)

### **The team**

Before starting Caddy, [Connor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/connor-waslo/) and [Rajiv](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rajivsancheti/) spent four years at Loom where they led product and design for Loom’s AI suite and core product.

launches.title: Lunavo - The AI assistant for trucking carrier operations
launches.tagline: AI that runs your backoffice - so your team can run logistics.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Niclas and Felix, and we’re launching Lunavo!

**TLDR:**

Lunavo is the AI assistant that automates the backoffice of trucking carriers so teams can focus on customers and growth.

_Launch Video:_

https://youtu.be/fKWHgdt8hv0 

**The problem:**

Trucking carriers coordinate complex operations to transport goods from A to B , but they spend most of their time on repetitive admin work like entering orders, updating portals, and checking systems. Most communication is still handled manually.

This creates two problems. First, teams waste hours on busywork instead of managing operations. Second, the noise makes it nearly impossible to spot issues that need attention until it's too late. A delayed pickup, missing document, or customer escalation only gets noticed when it's already urgent.

The real complexity isn't in data entry. It's in catching and resolving issues early: rerouting around delays, finding backup capacity, flagging exceptions before they cascade. Carriers need visibility and time to handle what matters, not endless manual updates.

We sat with dispatchers managing hundreds of shipments a day and saw their inbox and phone effectively act as their task managers.

·   Many handle between 50 and 100 emails per hour, and most of them are repetitive.

·   Teams constantly pull data from emails, PDFs, and portals into their Transport Management System (TMS).

·   They often jump between ten or more tools that don't communicate properly with each other.

Companies end up paying skilled employees to move data between tools instead of running logistics

**Our solution:**

Lunavo integrates into a carrier's existing systems as an AI teammate. When a new order arrives, it automatically extracts details, updates the TMS, and confirms with the customer. Dispatchers see: "New order from Customer X confirmed and scheduled."

**The system handles routine work while monitoring for exceptions** like delayed pickups, missing documents, or customer escalations, surfacing issues before they become urgent. It understands task dependencies and escalates only what needs human judgment.

Because logistics workflows often depend on implicit knowledge, our system can understand customer workflows and adapt to it. Our agents self-improve through dispatcher feedback, company documentation, and user-defined rules, automatically adapting to each customer's unique requirements without manual reconfiguration.

Lunavo manages to understand incoming documents, extract relevant information, challenges the inputs on plausibility and integrates them into the TMS. In case of anomalies, the system loops in the dispatcher:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95229&key=user_uploads/2331002/607a54fb-83cd-423d-8c36-312523817e4b)

**_Before Lunavo_**_:_ A driver is delayed. The dispatcher has to (1) log into the GPS portal, (2) inform the customer with an update, (3) manually update the TMS, and (4) update the customer's portal for delivery time. This takes up to 15 minutes of work.

**_With Lunavo:_** Lunavo detects the truck's GPS delay. It _automatically_ emails the customer, updates their portal, and sends a single notification to the dispatcher to keep him in the loop: "Driver 5 is delayed 30m. Customer X has been notified. No action needed."

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95229&key=user_uploads/2331002/bdb58f1b-2c10-4e29-b485-d64718f81c6f)

Lunavo helps trucking companies scale operations without scaling headcount.

**About us:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95229&key=user_uploads/2331002/531e2a61-c332-4ee9-ae0a-520a28e47341)

We're Felix and Niclas, founders of Lunavo. Together, we've spent the past years at the intersection of logistics and AI.

·   **Felix** worked with logistics and supply chain companies at McKinsey and later built a robotics logistics company in Germany, spending five years deeply embedded in the industry.

·   **Niclas** studied Computer Science at the Technical University of Munich and the University of Waterloo, focusing on AI security and applied machine learning

**Our ask:**

If you work in logistics or know someone running operations in road transportation, we would love to connect.

You can reach us at felix.loesch@lunavo.ai or visit [www.lunavo.ai](http://www.lunavo.ai).

launches.body:
Hello everyone! We’re [Anish](https://x.com/_anishgupta_) and [Marc](https://x.com/marczog), the Co-Founders of PlayVision!\
\
**TL;DR:** PlayVision lets basketball teams automatically analyze their practices and games to get advanced stats on their players, opponents, and college or high school recruits. We use AI and computer vision to get insights based on their tracking data.

https://youtu.be/MZynlUcUdeU

\
**The Problem**:

❌ Coaches spend over **75%** of their week watching film and manually tagging different stats.

❌ College Teams spend **$250K+** on services like HUDL, Synergy, HDI, and other different products just to watch film and scout players.

❌ There are up to **25x** more coaches between teams across Division 1 basketball — most programs lack the man-power to watch the same amount of film and create a comprehensive game-plan.

❌ College athletes are now able to get paid via their Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL). Teams are scrambling trying to figure out how much players are worth.\
\
**Our Solution**:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94935&key=user_uploads/2540850/425a0c3f-1d4d-4e7d-a46e-241f9655aa11)

An interactive platform that lets coaches upload their film and get the insights they want. We track every player, every movement, every decision made on the court. 

With our database, we also feature:

🏀 Our algorithms that rank every player in the country over the last **10** years.

🏀 Custom indexes where teams leverage over **40** metrics to create their own stats to rank players.

🏀 Automated scouting reports that give coaches **10x** the insights on their players and opponents in **10%** of the time.\
\
**Our Story:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94935&key=user_uploads/2540850/4ec6f501-bfc9-4758-81e5-910ce716dcc0)

\
I, Anish, was a massive sports fan growing up. I couldn’t play college athletics due to an eye surgery, so I joined Cal Athletics as a scout. I saw first-hand how tedious the manual film analysis was, having to stay late in the office with coaches trying to finish the games we set out to do.

launches.title: Logical: The Proactive Desktop Copilot
launches.tagline: Logical makes every knowledge worker 5x productive
launches.body:
Hi everyone,

We’re [Sam](http://linkedin.com/in/samurdhilbk) and [Anushka](http://linkedin.com/in/anushkaidamekorala/), co-founders of [Logical](https://trylogical.ai).

**TL;DR:**

**Logical is a copilot that lives on your desktop and proactively assists with things like drafting emails, meeting insights and tracking to-do items.**

Instead of waiting for you to prompt, Logical suggests context-aware actions in many common apps and services. It’s like Clippy, but actually good.

https://youtu.be/XfyPZb14LZM?si=aaJMF37-ipwkJBDV

### Problem

Prompt-first AI is fundamentally flawed. We waste hours every week writing lengthy prompts, context-switching and copy-pasting to get a chatbot to understand what we're doing. The context surrounding our work (emails, meeting notes, knowledge bases etc.) lives in siloed services that don't talk to each other. A truly helpful AI must live where we work: on the desktop.

### Solution

Logical lives on your desktop, observing your work to build an understanding of your intent and the context that surrounds it. As you switch between apps and tabs, Logical transfers that context with you.

It proactively suggests actions based on what you're doing—whether you're in Gmail, Slack, or Excel. This turns Logical into an all-in-one assistant: it's your email drafter, to-do manager, AI note-taker, and chatbot, all combined.

**📨 Email & Messaging Assistant:** Get quick drafts. Fine-tune, revert, and apply. Works with Gmail, Slack, iMessage and Apple Mail.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95304&key=user_uploads/2175254/ab0e8f09-c58c-45d7-8eef-0be23b97d326)

**✅ Automatic To-Do Detection**: Detects and drafts deliverables. Plus, it reminds you to get those done.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95304&key=user_uploads/2175254/afe169f0-7103-4fe7-aec1-a17e72157c74)

**🪄 Logical Lumos:** Get real-time assistance on any task. In Excel, it can suggest formulas and analyze errors; in a doc, it can explain terms as you highlight them. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95304&key=user_uploads/2175254/596d5046-364b-43b4-86c1-b63ea1b82b1a)

**🔗 Connect your services:** Bridge Gmail or your Calendar for deeper context. Search your email with natural language, or get quick calendar availability lookups.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95304&key=user_uploads/2175254/2b2a7df8-ff33-41f7-8770-5878ab4070af)

### Our story

Sam and Anushka have been friends since they met in grade school at 6 years old.

Before Logical, Sam worked on AI model optimizations at NVIDIA and previously dropped out of a PhD in applied AI. He's a medalist at both the IPhO and APhO and received a President’s Award for Scientific Research from the Government of Sri Lanka. Anushka dropped out of his PhD in context-aware predictive AI at UVA, and previously led B2B SaaS engineering teams.

Working in both academia and industry, we saw firsthand how most AI tools create friction and frustrate users. Our unique backgrounds – context-aware AI and AI model optimization – convinced us that an AI agent that lives on the desktop can identify user intent and provide proactive help, without compromising on speed or quality.

### Our Ask

If you're reading this, Logical can help you (yes, you!) get more done. Try it out at [**https://trylogical.ai**](https://trylogical.ai) – we offer generous free credits. Help us with feedback on how Logical can better fit your workflow.\
\
If you’re an enterprise, help your team miss fewer deadlines and spend less time context-switching. Plus, you can stop paying for 10 different AI add-on subscriptions – Logical can do it all. Contact us at [**hello@trylogical.ai**](mailto:hello@trylogical.ai) to learn more and book a demo.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
We (Anas and Pierre-Habté) met at UC Berkeley in 2017 and immediately started working together on tech projects. After co-founding Snipfeed, scaling it to 20+ people, and selling the company in 2024, we knew we wanted to build again together.

The idea for Bravi came from a very personal pain point: my family runs a shutter installation business in France, and I saw firsthand how many calls and leads were missed every day. On top of that, I launched a side business, Volet Dumont, selling shutters online, and experienced the same chaos with quoting and customer communication.

We realized installers were losing 30–40% of potential revenue just from slow follow-ups, missed calls, and disorganized workflows. With our background in automation and product scaling, we decided to tackle it head-on.

That’s how Bravi was born: combining our founder-market fit, validated by hundreds of conversations with installers, with the conviction that AI assistants could transform how home service companies capture and convert leads.

At the center is the _Assistant_ — your sidekick for daily work. It can send follow-ups, research leads, or add deals with a simple prompt. No complex UI, drop-downs or fields, simply ask.

For repeatable work, you build _Agents_ that you can train like new hires, simply by writing documents that describe your processes. item Agents run business processes across sales, support, and account management autonomously.

\
**The Status Quo**

AI has changed nearly every part of work. Yet the system at the center, the CRM, hasn’t evolved. It’s manual, data incomplete, and still takes trained experts to setup and automate.

We believe a CRM should know everything about your company and be able to do human-level work on your behalf, just like your best employee would.

launches.tagline: Automate any workflow and gain insights across your ERP, CRM, MES, Inbox, and more.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Manufacturers are buried in coordination work that is well-defined but still manual. Korso lets them describe those workflows in plain English and deploy autonomous agents that run across their existing systems.

## <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yOKcdERZe9w>

## The Problem

Ops, procurement, and customer-service teams at manufacturers spend the majority of their week on coordination that is clearly defined but never automated:

* Chasing suppliers for ETAs
* Processing incoming RFQs
* Routing PO approvals
* Monitoring order exceptions
* Following up on stale opportunities

Every person on one of these teams could write down the exact steps for the task, and yet nobody has built the thing that runs those steps reliably at scale.

The tooling around this problem is stuck in a half-finished state:

* ERP-native AI answers questions about ERP data; it doesn’t execute the multi-step workflows that sit between the data and the work getting done.
* Middleware and iPaaS connect systems but don’t make decisions.
* Systems integrators custom-code workflows that take quarters to ship and break when a process changes.
* BPO adds variable cost and leaves the underlying coordination fragmented.

When a manufacturer adds a product line, a new region, or a new supplier tier, the coordination load scales linearly, and so does the headcount requirement.

## What We Built

Atlas generates autonomous coordination agents on top of the ERP systems manufacturers already run: SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, Dynamics 365, Odoo, and more.

A workflow that today takes a quarter to custom-code or an ongoing BPO contract to staff is, on Atlas, described in plain English and stood up as a running agent in hours.

## Workflows We’ve Deployed

### Procurement & Supplier Coordination

Chases supplier responses, confirms ETAs, routes PO approvals, and escalates exceptions before they become missed deliveries.

### RFQ to Quote

Parses incoming RFQs from email or portal, prices against history and current cost, drafts and routes quotes for approval, and tracks through to response.

### Order & Exception Handling

Monitors order status across ERP and transport systems, surfaces exceptions before they escalate, and maintains a complete audit trail.

### Natural Language to Workflow

Turn any manual process into automation simply by prompting an agent.\
\
**Our Ask:**

If you know any manufacturer with a coordination-heavy ops or procurement team, we’d love to talk! Feel free to book a demo at [korsoai.com](https://korsoai.com) or reach out to [support@korsoai.com](https://mailto:support@korsoai.com)

launches.body:
**Hey everyone 👋**

I'm Justin, founder of Sidekick.

**TL;DR** Sidekick is an AI assistant that frontline manufacturing workers use over text message. They text a number and it answers from the company's own documents, creates and routes work orders, and syncs with the software the company already uses. No app, no login, no training. I built Sidekick for my dad's manufacturing shop. It’s now live at facilities across the globe.

**_Ask:_** Do you know anyone who owns or runs a manufacturing plant, warehouse, or industrial facility? I'd love an intro! Email [**justin@textsidekick.com**](mailto:justin@textsidekick.com) or [**book a demo**](https://calendly.com/justin-textsidekick).

Check out our launch video:

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yxwq5ZAojXg>

## ❌ The Problem

I grew up in my dad's manufacturing plants and spent summers working on the factory floor at EDS Manufacturing.

Here's what I watched happen repeatedly. A machine goes down, everyone's waiting, and the person who can help is in a meeting or on another line. Half the time the answer already existed. Nobody could get to it.

Why it keeps happening:

* **No computer access.** Nobody on that floor has a company login or an email address, so none of the plant's software reaches them.
* **The answers are scattered.** An SOP in a binder, a manual on a shared drive few have permissions to, a safety procedure someone printed and taped to a wall in 2019.
* **The best answers were never written down.** Thirty years of tribal knowledge lives in one guy's head, and when he retires it leaves with him.
* **So the same questions get asked over and over.** Shift after shift, and every one of them costs somebody their afternoon.

There are 239,000 manufacturing plants in the US, and only 29% of the people working in them have advanced digital skills. Any tool that requires a download, a login, and training makes adoption difficult.

## ✅ Our Solution

Workers text the Sidekick phone number. Problems, photos, voice memos, in any language. No app to download, no account to create, nothing to learn. Every worker on the floor already knows how to send a text, which is why adoption isn't a fight.

* **Answers from your own documents.** SOPs, manuals, safety procedures, tribal knowledge. Sidekick responds in the worker's language, in seconds.
* **Creates and routes the work order.** The issue gets logged and sent to the right person, without anyone needing a laptop.
* **Syncs with the software you already run.** Sidekick pulls from and writes to your existing systems instead of replacing them, and integrates directly through PLC and SCADA systems so the floor and the software finally see the same thing.
* **Captures tribal knowledge.** Every exchange builds a searchable knowledge base the company owns, so the know-how stays when the veteran leaves.

Here's a full walkthrough:

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a5zBRSXi-90>

## 👤 The Team

I'm Justin, founder and CEO. I'm the third generation in a manufacturing family, and I've been around plant floors since I was a kid. I studied Computer Science at the University of Pennsylvania, worked in finance at Arm, and left both to build Sidekick after watching the same problem play out on every floor I'd been on.

## 🙏 Our Ask

If you answer "yes" to any of these, I'd love your help:

* **Do you know anyone who owns or runs a manufacturing plant, warehouse, or industrial facility?** Even a name and a "you two should talk" goes a long way.
* **Have you sold software into manufacturing?** I'd love to hear what actually worked and what didn't.

Contact me at [**justin@textsidekick.com**](mailto:justin@textsidekick.com) or [**book a demo here**](https://calendly.com/justin-textsidekick)**.**

launches.title: Datost - The most accurate AI data analyst
launches.tagline: A proactive AI data analyst with a built in semantic layer that actually understands your business
launches.body:
Hey everyone — This is Maceo and Jason, founders of Datost.

**TL;DR:** Datost is an AI data analyst your team @mentions in Slack. It keeps a semantic layer of your business definitions so it understands what questions mean before writing SQL. On the hardest public text-to-SQL benchmark, it scores 75.2%. The best frontier model alone gets 33%.

**Why I built this**

We saw the problem while I was at Traba, a staffing marketplace. Traba had a lot of data and not enough analysts. Someone would need a number to make a decision, and the path to that number ran through SQL they couldn’t write or an analyst who was busy. The question would sit for hours. By the time the answer showed up, the decision had already been made on a guess.

There are AI analytics tools out there now. They all have the same problem: they don’t understand your business. When your PM asks “which accounts are at risk of churning,” there’s no column called that. “At risk” has a formula that lives in someone’s head, or a doc, or nowhere. These tools guess an interpretation and commit. Then someone in a Slack thread acts on the answer before anyone checks whether it was right.

**The semantic layer**

Datost maintains a layer of your team’s definitions, what “churn risk” means at your company, how you calculate NRR, which tables are trustworthy, what that internal acronym stands for.

When it hits a term it hasn’t seen, it looks it up the same way a new analyst would ask a coworker. When the semantic layer doesn’t have it either, it asks the user before writing any SQL.

It learns from mistakes too. When it gets something wrong, it leaves notes on the schema so it doesn’t make the same mistake twice. Teams that have been using it for a few months barely correct it anymore.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99800&key=user_uploads/3433862/f456e145-3c20-47ed-b570-06e70b3c6cda)

**What it actually does**

Your team @mentions Datost in any Slack channel. It searches the semantic layer, explores your schema in a sandbox, writes and tests SQL, then posts the answer in-thread with the work shown. A second model reviews every answer read-only. If the definition says one thing and the SQL does another, the reviewer catches it.

It also runs on its own. You can set it up to post a pipeline coverage update to #sales every Monday, or flag when a metric moves outside a range you care about. Or if youre old fashioned it can make a beautiful dashboard for you :)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99800&key=user_uploads/3433862/f5c22b08-a608-47cd-a986-785487b6935e)

It connects to Postgres, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks. Also Datadog, Sentry, PostHog, Coda, Notion, GitHub, and anything else via MCP. It reads your Slack history to see how things were answered before. It reads your codebase to understand how a metric is actually calculated. Charts, dashboards, PDFs, exports, whatever format you need. Most answers come back in under a minute.

**The benchmark**

We ran Datost against BIRD-Interact, the hardest public text-to-SQL benchmark. 600 deliberately ambiguous questions across 22 messy and realistic PostgreSQL databases, published at ICLR 2026. Every question uses terms that aren’t in the schema.

Claude Opus 4.6, the model Datost runs on, gets 33% on its own. Datost scored 75.2%. Same model. The gap is the semantic layer. On analytical questions, 91%.

Full breakdown here: <https://datost.com/blog/bird-interact>

**Ask**

If your team has a Slack, Teams, or Google Chat workspace and data people keep asking about, we can get you running in a day.

* [**Book a call**](https://datost.cal.com/founders/30-min)
* Email me or Jason: [maceo@datost.com](mailto:maceo@datost.com) or [jason@datost.com](mailto:jason@datost.com)  
* Or reply here

name: Moonshot
long_description:
We want to bring AI agents to a billion people.

To do this, we believe it needs to be 1. proactive and 2. personal. A billion people already carry the right device, but none of them have the right connector.

Moonshot is personal intelligence that lives on your iPhone and listens to you 24/7. It continuously builds up a greater understanding of you through constantly listening and building context. It just pays deep attention, the way a good friend does. Through this, Moonshot monitors your conscious and subconscious life, figuring out what you need before you know, reminding you about open loops, identifying life and emotional trends before you recognize it, and covering a lot more of what we gloss over in daily life.

For fifty years, software has waited to be asked. We think tools are just good enough to flip this, and the next great software will provide value before asking for something first. We're doing it through Moonshot.

Our thesis is simple: you're only living half your life. The half that you actively remember. The other half just evaporates into your subconscious: what you said, felt, promised, and forgot. It's the more interesting half, and until now nothing could catch it, making it not actionable.

Moonshot catches your subconscious half and understands you well enough to take actions on your behalf.

Take life personally.

The iOS app is designed around ambient listening and clear user control. Short microphone chunks are sent securely to Moonshot's private transcription service and deleted when transcription finishes. Text and selected context can be sent through Moonshot's server to a model when the app needs to understand a moment. Nothing leaves without your yes. The privacy policy explains every data path, stored copy, permission, and deletion control in detail.

Moonshot is in early access. Join the waitlist to hear when access opens, read more about the team and product on the About page, or use the Contact page for a direct written response from the Moonshot team.

Let's make it a Moonshot.

name: Egoist Machines
long_description:
Egoist Machines is building infrastructure for a world where your personal context belongs to you, rather than to the apps and AI companies you use. Today, every assistant and consumer app builds its own version of you. We think that architecture is backwards. Your context should live with you, persist across products, and be available to any model, app or agent you choose.

AI Passport is the first layer of that infrastructure. It brings the context you generate across AI assistants and everyday apps into one portable profile you control. Tell ChatGPT something and Claude can already know it, for example. Switch to a new product and it can understand you from the first interaction, without the new company needing to own the underlying data.

Apps integrate through Sign in with AI Passport, requesting only the context they need for a specific purpose and duration. Users can see what is being accessed and revoke that access later. Underneath, we have built our own memory infrastructure for fast, compact per-user retrieval and permissioned access.

We are distributing AI Passport directly to consumers through first-party products, while integrating it into consumer applications with existing distribution. Every new product that uses Passport gives users another reason to maintain their context there, and every additional Passport holder makes the context layer more useful to developers.

The next step is to build a true Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents. We call it Digital Domovoy, the hardware extension of AI Passport. Instead of your most personal context ultimately living on somebody else's servers, it lives and is processed locally on hardware you control. AI Passport becomes the permission layer between that private local context and the cloud models and internet services you choose to use.

Our North Star is the Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents.

launches.title: Egoist Machines: user-owned hyper-personalisation infrastructure for Web 4.0
launches.tagline: One portable, permissioned memory and context layer for hyper-personalisation across every AI application.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We are building AI Passport, the user-owned context layer for consumer AI. It lets people carry their personal context between products while controlling exactly what each product can access, why, and for how long.

Read our manifesto for the bigger vision: <https://ego.ist/notes/the-egoist-machine>

Create your AI Passport to start taking control of your data: <https://ego.ist/>

**Ask**: if you’re working on a consumer-facing AI application, or know someone who is, we’d love to chat: [founders@ego.ist](mailto:founders@ego.ist)

<https://youtu.be/nLnZNjyHV0s>

The next era of consumer technology will be **hyper-personalised**. The products that understand each user from the very first interaction will create fundamentally better experiences and, we believe, the next consumer decacorns. People increasingly lack the time and patience to train every new product from scratch.

The main blocker to ubiquitous consumer AI is that every major AI assistant and consumer app is building its own private and incomplete model of the same person. ChatGPT holds one model, Claude another, while the data in health apps, calendar, shopping history, travel accounts, wearables, and financial tools remain trapped in separate silos. No product has the complete context needed to understand you, and no user has a single place from which to control it.

As a result:

\- Users get bored of repeatedly explaining themselves;

\- Companies spend money building context that already exists;

\- Personal data remains trapped inside platforms the user does not control.

The natural end state of this inefficiency is one user-owned memory and context layer that sits above individual products. Apps request the specific context they need, and users grant scoped, time-limited access instead of permanently surrendering their data.

**_That is AI Passport_**.

---

## How AI Passport works

AI Passport is a centralised, user-controlled home for personal context.

You can think of it as **Link for personal context**. Link lets people securely save their payment and shipping information once and reuse it across businesses; AI Passport does the same for _all_ your context, including preferences, interests, goals, history, health, travel, and so much more.

Users bring this context into one centralised AI Passport by connecting the apps and AI assistants they already use. They can also save anything they discover online or on social media directly to their Passport. New information enters an approval inbox, where the user decides whether it becomes _private memory_ or part of their _living, shareable public profile_.

That same Passport then becomes a plug-and-play connector for consumer apps through our **Sign in with AI Passport** OAuth system:

1\. An app requests the specific context it needs.

2\. The user sees exactly what is being requested, why it is needed, and how long access will last.

3\. The user can approve, edit, or deny the request, with the option to grant one-time, time-limited, or continuing access .

4\. Every permission can later be inspected or revoked.

We are launching AI Passport directly to consumers and through distribution and deep-integration partners collectively reaching millions of users across dining, ride-hailing, wearables, healthcare, lifestyle, finance and more.

We built a custom memory backend for AI Passport. It is optimised for compact, exact retrieval across isolated per-user memory stores and supports cryptographic access control at the memory layer. The retrieval path is constrained by the user's active permission, so the product can access only the context authorised for that purpose and period.

---

## Who we are

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=111045&key=user_uploads/3328552/4bb1bba6-8c9f-4d94-b88a-28051f5e6e45)

**Dr David Khachaturov** holds a PhD (Uni of Cambridge) in Computer Science and is the youngest-ever Fellow at St Catharine's College, Cambridge. Previously an ML Researcher at OpenAI (PaperBench) and Lead AI Security Researcher at FrontierOne.

**Erin Meryl McGurk** grew 0 to 1M followers on socials in one year. Advised Uni of Cambridge, UK Govt, OpenAI on social media strategy. Founded social enterprise Girl Economics to 15 countries, 75 ambassadors, 10+ weekly events.

---

## Our Ask

**For users:** create your AI Passport (<https://ego.ist>) and tell us what you think!

**For builders:** if you are building a product that could benefit from richer user context, explore our developer docs (<https://ego.ist/docs>) and feel free to reach out to [founders@ego.ist](mailto:founders@ego.ist).

We would especially value introductions to teams building consumer AI, wearables, health products, commerce experiences, or agents that need bounded access to sensitive personal information. If that is you, I want to chat: <https://calendar.app.google/qT5ccAUEqB9V82Uz9>
